config.description: Patch non-secret fields of one server; omitted fields and existing credentials are preserved. New stdio servers require command; HTTP/SSE servers require url. Use null to remove an obsolete string field when switching transport. Credentials, environment and headers are entered through the protected MCP settings flow, never by reading existing secrets or putting secrets in command/args/url. Saving reconciles runtime state; autoStart defaults to true. Inspect the returned status instead of assuming connection succeeded.

capabilities.titleZh: 首页、全局搜索与分栏工作台
capabilities.summaryZh: 从首页总览快速进入常用资产与设备，按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 一键搜索消息、文件、命令与设置，并用双栏工作台或悬浮窗自由组织屏幕空间。
capabilities.summaryEn: Jump into agents, apps, skills, and devices from Home, press ⌘K / Ctrl+K to search messages, files, commands, and settings anywhere, and arrange work across split panes or a compact floating window.
highlightsZh: 在「首页」一站查看连续活跃天数、Token 热力图、已连设备、智能体、小应用与技能
按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 全局搜索会话消息、代码文件、功能与设置，输入 > 直接过滤并执行命令
会话与代码/终端自动左右并排展示，支持拖拽标签、最大化分栏与重新打开刚关掉的标签
按个人习惯固定左侧边栏常用入口，或一键切到轻量「悬浮窗模式」边看资料边对话
highlightsEn: Check your activity heatmap, streaks, connected devices, agents, Mini Apps, and Skills from Home
Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K anywhere to search messages, files, features, and settings — or type > for commands
Keep chat and files/terminals side by side with drag-and-drop tabs, split shortcuts, and tab restore
Pin your favorite pages to the left sidebar or collapse into Floating window mode over other apps

items.titleZh: 在「首页」总览活跃度热力图、已关联设备，并快捷启动智能体、助理、小应用与技能
items.titleEn: Review your activity heatmap and connected devices on Home, with quick actions for Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, and Skills

control.reasonZh: 「在「首页」总览活跃度热力图、已关联设备，并快捷启动智能体、助理、小应用与技能」需要结合你在首页卡片上的实时浏览与点选目标来完成操作；智能体可为你直接打开首页，方便你查看概览或点击对应模块。
control.reasonEn: “Review your activity heatmap and connected devices on Home, with quick actions for Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, and Skills” depends on what you want to inspect or launch from the live Home dashboard; the Agent opens Home directly so you can act in place.

items.titleZh: 用全局搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）跨项目检索消息、文件、功能与设置，或输入 > 运行命令
items.titleEn: Search across messages, sessions, files, features, and settings with ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or type > to run commands

control.reasonZh: 「用全局搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）跨项目检索消息、文件、功能与设置，或输入 > 运行命令」需要你输入关键词并在实时匹配的会话、文件或命令结果中挑选目标；智能体也可通过内置控制工具直接帮你跳转到明确的功能或设置页。
control.reasonEn: “Search across messages, sessions, files, features, and settings with ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or type > to run commands” lets you type queries and pick from live session, file, action, and settings matches; you can also ask the Agent to open a specific page directly.

items.titleZh: 在双栏工作台中并排查看会话与代码/终端，拖拽移动标签页或使用分屏快捷键
items.titleEn: Work side by side in the split workbench with draggable tabs, pane maximize, and canvas overview shortcuts

control.reasonZh: 分栏比例、标签拖拽位置与面板焦点属于窗口视觉布局交互，由你在顶部标签栏与分割线上直接拖拽或按键完成。
control.reasonEn: Pane sizing, tab drag-and-drop placement, and split focus are visual layout interactions controlled directly via the tab bar, splitter, or keyboard shortcuts.

items.titleZh: 自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标
items.titleEn: Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts

control.reasonZh: 「自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标」属于当前窗口的个性化导航偏好，可在外观设置的「左侧导航栏」分区中按个人习惯勾选和调整顺序。
control.reasonEn: “Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts” is a personal navigation preference configured interactively in Appearance settings under Left sidebar or from Mini App menus.

items.titleZh: 一键切换到轻量「悬浮窗模式」，在其他应用上方随时发起对话或恢复主窗口
items.titleEn: Switch into compact Floating window mode to chat alongside other desktop apps and restore the main window anytime

control.reasonZh: 「一键切换到轻量「悬浮窗模式」，在其他应用上方随时发起对话或恢复主窗口」涉及本机桌面窗口形态与屏幕位置切换，需由你在左下角菜单中手动开启或点恢复按钮回到主窗口。
control.reasonEn: “Switch into compact Floating window mode to chat alongside other desktop apps and restore the main window anytime” changes the local desktop window geometry and focus, so you trigger it from the bottom-left menu and restore the full window when ready.

stepsZh: 点击左侧边栏顶部的「首页」查看你的设备、智能体、小应用、小卡片和技能概览
随时按 ⌘K（Windows/Linux 按 Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）打开全局搜索；直接输入文字搜会话与文件，输入 > 查看可执行命令
在会话中点开任意文件或按 ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+` 打开终端，拖动顶部标签页即可在左右分栏间自由摆放
想把常用入口常驻在左侧边栏时，前往「设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,）→ 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」勾选并排序
stepsEn: Click Home at the top of the left sidebar to see your devices, agents, Mini Apps, desktop cards, and Skills at a glance
Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K or Alt+F on Windows/Linux) anywhere to search sessions, files, features, and settings — or type > to filter commands
Open any file or press ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+` for a terminal beside your chat, and drag tabs between left and right panes
To keep favorite pages in the sidebar, go to Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Appearance → Left sidebar
agentExamplesZh: 帮我打开键盘快捷键设置
带我去外观设置调整左侧导航栏
打开任务看板看看今天有哪些计划任务
agentExamplesEn: Open keyboard shortcut settings for me
Take me to Appearance settings so I can customize the left sidebar
Open the Task Board so I can check today’s scheduled runs

capabilities.titleZh: AI 会话与多模式协作
capabilities.summaryZh: 围绕项目开展持久对话：按任务挑选「标准 / 极致 / 办公协作 / 深度研究 / 论文写作 / 电脑操作 / 创造」等模式，用 @ 挂载文件与历史会话、用 /goal 持续推进目标，还能直接生成图片与 Office 文档。
capabilities.summaryEn: Collaborate in durable project sessions: switch between Standard, Ultimate, Cowork, Deep Research, Paper Writing, Computer Use, or Creative modes, attach files and past sessions with @, drive multi-turn goals with /goal, and generate images or Office files.
highlightsZh: 内置「标准、极致、极简、办公协作、深度研究、论文写作、电脑操作、创造、助理」等模式，各司其职
输入框键入 @ 即可联合引用文件、目录、历史会话、Skills、MCP 与图片；键入 / 触发 /goal、/btw、/compact、/init
运行中随时插话引导（Steer）或排队追加消息；选中任意回复文字可批量「添加批注」或发起不跑题的「侧边提问」
原生支持生成图片与免安装 Office 读写 Word（.docx）、Excel（.xlsx）、PowerPoint（.pptx）
highlightsEn: Built-in modes tailored to every job: Standard, Ultimate, Minimal, Cowork, Deep Research, Paper Writing, Computer Use, Creative, and Assistant
Type @ to attach files, folders, past sessions, Skills, MCP servers, or images; type / for /goal, /btw, /compact, and /init
Steer or queue follow-ups mid-run, or highlight any reply text to batch-submit numbered annotations or ask a side question
Generate images natively and create or revise Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) files without Office installed

items.titleZh: 打开会话场景并快速新建一个 AI 会话
items.titleEn: Open the Session view and start a new AI conversation

items.titleZh: 筛选、重命名、复制、从任意轮次分叉（Fork）、归档恢复与导出会话记录
items.titleEn: Filter, rename, duplicate, fork from any turn, archive, restore, and export sessions

control.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖选中的会话、分叉轮次或删除确认；智能体可准确打开会话界面，由你挑选目标会话或历史节点。
control.reasonEn: These actions depend on the selected session, chosen turn to fork from, or deletion confirmation; the Agent opens the session UI so you can pick the exact target.

items.titleZh: 按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式
items.titleEn: Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session

control.reasonZh: 「按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式」与你当前正在编辑的会话状态紧密相关；智能体可为你打开当前会话入口，方便你在输入框栏直观挑选模式与模型。
control.reasonEn: “Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session” is tied to the live session composer where you can pick modes, models, reasoning effort, and approval posture interactively.

items.titleZh: 在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、目录、历史会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令
items.titleEn: Attach files, folders, past sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $

control.reasonZh: 「在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、目录、历史会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令」是在撰写消息时的实时上下文拼装与命令补全交互，由你在当前聊天输入框中点选确认后一并发送。
control.reasonEn: “Attach files, folders, past sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $” is an interactive composer workflow where you pick context chips and slash commands while drafting your prompt.

items.titleZh: 在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务
items.titleEn: Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode

control.reasonZh: “在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务”需要用户在当前输入框选择服务并编辑草稿，没有可直接完成该交互的结构化 Command。也可通过工具名称或描述搜索所属服务；工具不会单独列出。目录按当前主机、工作区和模式过滤；Minimal 隐藏 MCP 入口。远程工作区暂不支持此选择器，Peer Host 必须协商 chat_mcp_catalog_v1 能力。
control.reasonEn: “Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode” requires the user to select a server and edit the current composer draft; no structured Command completes that interaction directly. Tool names and descriptions can find their owning server without separate tool rows. The catalog is scoped to the current host, workspace, and mode; Minimal hides MCP. Remote workspaces are unsupported; Peer Hosts must advertise chat_mcp_catalog_v1.

items.titleZh: 划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」
items.titleEn: Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question

control.reasonZh: 「划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」」依赖你在会话消息中划选的具体段落与批注内容，开启文本选择工具栏后选中文字即可直接触发。
control.reasonEn: “Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question” starts from highlighting specific text in the conversation transcript and writing your note or side question in place.

items.titleZh: 在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次
items.titleEn: Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns

control.reasonZh: 「在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次」取决于当前会话正处于思考、工具执行还是中断状态，你可在聊天输入框与队列条上直接操作。
control.reasonEn: “Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns” depends on the live execution state of the active turn and is controlled directly from the chat composer and pending queue bar.

items.titleZh: 审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝
items.titleEn: Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback

control.reasonZh: 「审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝」是保障你环境安全的人工审批边界，必须由你在桌面端或远控端亲自确认，智能体绝不会替你点同意。
control.reasonEn: “Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback” is an explicit human safety boundary that you confirm in the session or from a remote controller; the Agent never self-approves.

items.titleZh: 用 /goal 创建跨轮次持久会话目标，让智能体自主推进直到真正达成
items.titleEn: Set a persistent multi-turn session goal with /goal so the agent keeps driving until completion

workflowZh: 先用 get_goal 查看当前目标；没有目标时仅在用户明确要求后用 create_goal 创建
目标真正达成时才用 update_goal 标记 complete；同一阻塞条件连续满足门槛且无法继续时才标记 blocked
workflowEn: Inspect the current goal with get_goal; create one with create_goal only when the user explicitly asks
Use update_goal complete only after the objective is achieved, and blocked only after the repeated-blocker threshold is genuinely met

items.titleZh: 在会话顶部目标条随时修改目标描述或清除当前目标
items.titleEn: Edit the active goal objective or clear the session goal from the goal banner

control.reasonZh: 目标工具只负责读取、创建和受约束的状态转换；修改目标文本与清除目标在当前会话顶部目标栏中由你直接确认完成。
control.reasonEn: Goal tools cover discovery, creation, and guarded status transitions; editing objective text or clearing the goal is done directly in the session goal banner.

items.titleZh: 让智能体拆解待办进度、编写 .openbitfun/plans 实施计划，并在关键分岔点向你提问确认
items.titleEn: Let the agent track step-by-step todos, write .openbitfun/plans specs, and ask clarifying questions when choices matter

workflowZh: 复杂任务用 TodoWrite 维护当前进度；正式计划产物通过 Write 写入项目的 .openbitfun/plans 目录
缺少会改变结果的用户选择时用 AskUserQuestion；能从仓库或当前上下文查明的信息不重复询问
workflowEn: Use TodoWrite to maintain progress for complex work; create formal plan artifacts with Write under the project's .openbitfun/plans directory
Use AskUserQuestion only for a missing choice that changes the outcome; do not ask again for facts available from the repository or current context

items.titleZh: 使用 BTW 轻量问答与编辑器内联 AI，并可随时取消
items.titleEn: Use lightweight BTW questions and inline editor AI, with cancellation

control.reasonZh: “使用 BTW 轻量问答与编辑器内联 AI，并可随时取消”由多个实时状态相关步骤组成，目前没有一个能确定完成整个流程的单一结构化 Command；智能体会打开精确入口，并把后续交互保留在用户可见界面。
control.reasonEn: “Use lightweight BTW questions and inline editor AI, with cancellation” spans multiple live-state-dependent steps and currently has no single structured Command that can deterministically complete the whole workflow; the Agent opens the exact entry and keeps the remaining interaction visible to the user.

items.titleZh: 切换到「创造（Creative）」模式，安全定制正在运行的 OpenBitFun 界面与交互能力
items.titleEn: Switch to Creative mode to customize the live OpenBitFun interface with automatic 15-second rollback protection

workflowZh: 在本地桌面创造模式中调用 FrontendWorkbench prepare，阅读随包 API；只编辑草稿中的 CSS、JavaScript 和自有资源，无需源码或构建工具
用原草稿 ID 调用 apply；宿主在真实界面和自定义代码激活后才启动不可变确认窗口的 15 秒倒计时，apply 会等待并返回 confirmed 或 rolled_back 的最终结果
用 commands、state 和 events 组合可复用能力；通过 FrontendWorkbench inspect 发现命令和错误，再按 schema 用 invoke 验证执行
workflowEn: Call FrontendWorkbench prepare on the local Desktop in Creative mode, read the packaged API, and edit only draft CSS, JavaScript and owned assets without source or build tools

Apply with the original draft ID; the host starts the immutable review window's 15-second countdown only after the real shell and customization activate, and apply waits for a final confirmed or rolled_back outcome
Compose commands, state and events into reusable capabilities; use FrontendWorkbench inspect to discover schemas and diagnostics, then invoke to verify execution

items.titleZh: 通过已配置的默认图像模型在对话中直接生成配图与素材
items.titleEn: Generate illustrations, icons, and visual assets directly in chat with your configured image model

workflowZh: 使用 generate_image 按用户描述生成图片，默认省略 service_id 以使用已配置的默认图像模型
按需指定数量和尺寸，通过返回的文件路径交付图片；远程工作区文件通过当前工作区数据面读写
缺少配置、认证失败或额度不足时明确报告，不自动切换到其他服务
workflowEn: Use generate_image to create images from the user's description; omit service_id to use the configured default image model
Specify count and size when needed and deliver the returned file paths; access remote workspace files through the active workspace data plane
Report missing configuration, authentication failures, or quota limits explicitly without automatically switching services

items.titleZh: 用 GenOfficeFile 免安装 Office 创建并编辑 Word、Excel 与 PowerPoint 文档
items.titleEn: Create and revise Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files with GenOfficeFile — no Office installation required

workflowZh: 先用 GenOfficeFile guide 读取格式指南，再通过 create 和 edit 分批生成或修改 .docx、.xlsx、.pptx 文件，无需安装 Office
用 read 分页查看文档结构；文件和引用图片通过当前工作区文件系统读写，支持本地或远程工作区
仅能继续编辑由该工具生成的文件；其他程序改过的内容默认拒绝覆盖，需要用户明确同意丢弃外部修改
workflowEn: Read the format guide with GenOfficeFile guide, then use create and edit to build or revise .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files in batches without installing Office
Use read to page through document structure; documents and referenced images use the active local or remote workspace filesystem
Only files generated by this tool can be reopened for editing; external changes are rejected by default and may be discarded only with the user's explicit agreement

items.titleZh: 展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令
items.titleEn: Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands

control.reasonZh: 「展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令」与会话中实时滚动的工具卡片和后台进程状态绑定，可直接在对话流中点开查看或控制。
control.reasonEn: “Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands” is bound to live tool cards and background process activity inside the active conversation stream.

items.titleZh: 点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率
items.titleEn: Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits

control.reasonZh: 「点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率」在当前会话状态栏按需估算并展开展示，点击分类即可预览具体注入的上下文片段。
control.reasonEn: “Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits” is computed on demand from the session status bar so you can inspect and preview each context category interactively.

items.titleZh: 用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆
items.titleEn: Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory

control.reasonZh: 「用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆」涵盖多个针对当前会话上下文与记忆库的交互动作，可通过聊天斜杠命令或会话与记忆设置执行。
control.reasonEn: “Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory” combines session slash commands and memory maintenance controls that you trigger in chat or Sessions & Memory settings.

items.titleZh: 按页回溯超长历史会话，或让智能体跨会话检索过往讨论与决策记录
items.titleEn: Page smoothly through long transcripts or let the agent search indexed history across past sessions

workflowZh: 先用 SessionControl 的 list 找到目标会话，再用 SessionHistory 导出带索引的会话记录
先只读取导出文件的索引区，再用 Read 或 Grep 定位并读取需要的轮次，避免把完整历史塞进上下文
workflowEn: Use SessionControl list to find the target session, then export its indexed transcript with SessionHistory
Read only the exported index first, then use Read or Grep for the required turns instead of loading the entire history into context

items.titleZh: 让智能体跨工作区列出、新建会话，或把子任务发给另一个持久会话接力完成
items.titleEn: Let an agent create or list sessions across workspaces and hand off work to another persisted session

workflowZh: 用 ListWorkspaces 获取运行主机登记的 workspace_id，再传给 SessionControl.workspace 创建或列出本地或远程会话；绝对路径仅在调用者执行环境中解析；取消只终止当前轮次，删除是独立动作
需要让另一持久会话接手工作时用 SessionMessage，并保留异步返回；跨远程边界时沿用目标会话绑定，不得复用控制器路径
workflowEn: Use ListWorkspaces to discover runtime-host workspace IDs, then pass one as SessionControl.workspace to create or list local or remote sessions; absolute paths resolve in the caller environment; cancel affects only the active turn and delete is separate
Use SessionMessage when another persisted session should take over work and retain its asynchronous result; preserve the target session binding across remote boundaries

items.titleZh: 从项目或会话右键菜单一键打开本机会话存储目录，方便手动备份或排查
items.titleEn: Reveal the local session storage folder from workspace or session menus for backup and troubleshooting

control.reasonZh: 需要用户选择工作区或会话，并在本机桌面文件管理器中操作；远程工作区打开本机保存的会话镜像，对端设备和 Detached Dispatch 会话不支持此操作。打开目录不会修改会话归属。
control.reasonEn: The user selects a workspace or session and works in the local desktop file manager; remote workspaces reveal their locally stored session mirror, while peer and detached-dispatch sessions are unsupported. Opening storage does not change session ownership.

stepsZh: 在侧边栏项目名旁点「新建会话」（或按 ⌘Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+A 进入会话后按 ⌘N / Ctrl+N）
在输入框下方选择适合当前任务的模式（如日常开发选「标准」，深度攻关选「极致」，写文档选「办公协作」）与模型
输入 @ 添加相关文件、目录或过往会话作为上下文，描述你想达成的效果；长任务可在开头加 `/goal `
运行过程中可随时发送新消息引导方向、审批权限卡片，或划选回复内容添加批注与侧边提问
stepsEn: Click New session beside your project in the sidebar (or press ⌘Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+A, then ⌘N / Ctrl+N)
Pick the mode that fits your task in the composer bar (Standard for daily coding, Ultimate for deep problem-solving, Cowork for documents) and choose a model
Type @ to attach relevant files, folders, or past sessions, then describe what you need — prefix with `/goal ` for persistent multi-turn objectives
While running, send follow-ups to steer, approve permission prompts, or highlight reply text to add batch annotations or ask a side question
agentExamplesZh: 新建一个会话，帮我排查为什么登录接口偶发返回 401
/goal 把 auth 模块的单元测试补齐并全部跑通
根据这份接口说明帮我生成一份结构清晰的 .xlsx 测试用例表和 .pptx 评审简报
翻一下我上周关于缓存改造的历史会话，把当时敲定的键名规范整理出来
agentExamplesEn: Start a new session and help me debug why the login endpoint intermittently returns 401
/goal Add unit tests for the auth module and iterate until the whole suite passes
Create a clean .xlsx test matrix and a .pptx review deck from this API spec
Search my session history from last week on cache redesign and summarize the key naming rules we agreed on

capabilities.titleZh: 智能体管理与并行子智能体
capabilities.summaryZh: 查看和定制不同专长的智能体角色，按需裁剪每个角色的工具与 Skills 边界，并让主智能体在复杂任务中自动派生多个子智能体并行调研、编码与审查。
capabilities.summaryEn: Browse and customize specialized agents, tailor each role’s allowed tools and Skills, and let your primary agent spawn parallel subagents for codebase exploration, implementation, and review.
highlightsZh: 内置代码探索、通用执行、深度评审、研究专家与多角色协作等专业子智能体
支持创建用户级自定义模式智能体与项目级专属子智能体（如前端规范检查员、SQL 审计员）
可精细到按角色勾选工具组、单个工具与 Skills，只读角色天然禁止改动代码更放心
主智能体可一次派生多个子智能体并行工作，并在会话中直观展示每个子智能体的进度与产出
highlightsEn: Built-in specialist subagents for fast codebase exploration, implementation, deep review, and research
Create user-level custom modes or repo-specific project subagents (e.g., API reviewer, migration helper)
Scope each agent’s exact tool groups, individual tools, Skills, and read-only guardrails
Let the primary agent fan out bounded subtasks in parallel and synthesize their findings automatically

items.titleZh: 按内置、个人、项目与外部来源分类浏览当前环境可用的全部智能体
items.titleEn: Browse built-in, personal, project, and external agents available in the current environment

control.reasonZh: 「按内置、个人、项目与外部来源分类浏览当前环境可用的全部智能体」需要结合当前主机与工作区的实时目录进行筛选查看；智能体可为你直接打开智能体管理中心。
control.reasonEn: “Browse built-in, personal, project, and external agents available in the current environment” displays live agent catalogs scoped to your active host and workspace; the Agent opens the Agents gallery directly for you.

items.titleZh: 创建自定义主对话智能体，设定专属名称、职责说明与系统提示词

control.reasonEn: “Create custom primary agents with their own name, description, and role instructions” lets you author role instructions and pick allowed capabilities in the creation dialog.

items.titleZh: 查看详情、随时微调提示词、热重载配置或删除不再需要的自定义智能体

control.reasonEn: “Inspect, edit instructions, hot-reload, or remove custom agents anytime” targets the specific custom agent you select for editing, reloading, or removal in the Agents view.

items.titleZh: 创建与维护可被主智能体自动委派的个人级或项目级子智能体

items.titleZh: 按智能体精细开关工具组、单个工具与 Skills，并随时一键恢复默认配置

workflowZh: 使用 AgentSpawn 启动有边界的子任务，并保留返回的 agent_id
用 AgentList/AgentWait 查看进度；需要调整时用 AgentSendInput，必要时再中断或删除，最终综合子智能体结果

capabilities.titleZh: 个人助理（长期人设与专属空间）
capabilities.summaryZh: 拥有独立工作区、长期记忆与鲜明性格的随身 AI 伙伴：不局限于单个代码仓库，可随时陪你梳理日常事务、撰写文档、跟进长期计划并运行专属定时任务。
capabilities.summaryEn: Create long-lived AI companions with their own workspace, memory, and Markdown persona documents — ideal for ongoing daily planning, writing, research, and assistant-scoped scheduled jobs beyond any single repo.
highlightsZh: 不绑定特定代码目录，适合管理跨项目长期事务、个人知识库、读书笔记与日常待办
可视化设定名字、形象气质与头像，底层直接映射为自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md
支持创建多个不同定位的个人助理（如「每日效率管家」「英语写作教练」），并指定一个主助理
在助理详情页可直接发起对话、回看专属历史会话，并配置只属于该助理的定时任务
highlightsEn: Lives in its own dedicated assistant workspace — great for daily planning, notes, writing, and cross-project rituals
Customize name, vibe, and avatar while editing plain-text IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents with autosave
Keep multiple specialized assistants (e.g., Daily Chief of Staff, Writing Coach) and designate a Primary Assistant
Start chats, browse past conversations, and manage assistant-scoped scheduled jobs from one clean page

items.titleZh: 在助理空间一览全部个人助理、查看人设与能力摘要，并一键创建新助理
items.titleEn: Browse all your personal assistants, review their persona and capability summaries, and create new ones in one click

control.reasonZh: 「在助理空间一览全部个人助理、查看人设与能力摘要，并一键创建新助理」需要你在助理空间中浏览卡片并确认新建或进入哪个助理；智能体可为你直接打开助理空间。
control.reasonEn: “Browse all your personal assistants, review their persona and capability summaries, and create new ones in one click” opens the Assistant gallery where you can browse existing companions, create a new one, or jump into its configuration.

items.titleZh: 把暂时不用的助理从侧边栏收起（完整保留人设与历史），需要时随时重新打开
items.titleEn: Hide inactive assistants from the sidebar while keeping their persona and history intact, and reopen them anytime

control.reasonZh: 关闭操作依赖用户选择的助理；助理空间保留完整目录，并提供重新打开入口。
control.reasonEn: Closing depends on the assistant selected by the user; the gallery retains the complete catalog and provides a reopen action.

items.titleZh: 将最常用的伙伴设为「主助理」、删除不再需要的副助理，或一键重置为初始状态
items.titleEn: Designate your Primary Assistant, remove extra assistants, or reset an assistant workspace back to defaults

control.reasonZh: 「将最常用的伙伴设为「主助理」、删除不再需要的副助理，或一键重置为初始状态」涉及影响长期记忆与历史记录的确认动作，由你在助理详情菜单中核对后执行。
control.reasonEn: “Designate your Primary Assistant, remove extra assistants, or reset an assistant workspace back to defaults” includes destructive reset and deletion confirmations that remain safely under your explicit control in the UI.

items.titleZh: 定制助理昵称、角色设定与说话气质，并挑选官方插画头像、Emoji 或自定义字符
items.titleEn: Edit an assistant’s name, role archetype, and conversational vibe, and pick a preset avatar, emoji, or custom glyph

control.reasonZh: 「定制助理昵称、角色设定与说话气质，并挑选官方插画头像、Emoji 或自定义字符」属于可视化的形象与气质编辑流程，可在助理配置页边改边看实时效果。
control.reasonEn: “Edit an assistant’s name, role archetype, and conversational vibe, and pick a preset avatar, emoji, or custom glyph” is a visual customization flow on the assistant detail page with live avatar preview.

items.titleZh: 直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节
items.titleEn: Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown

control.reasonZh: 「直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节」需要你在助理配置页的文档编辑器中审阅与撰写人设正文，所有改动会自动同步保存。
control.reasonEn: “Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown” provides an interactive Markdown editor with frontmatter synchronization right inside the assistant configuration page.

items.titleZh: 从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话
items.titleEn: Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page

control.reasonZh: 「从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话」结合了快速输入草稿与历史会话点选，智能体可为你打开该助理主页以便立即开始。
control.reasonEn: “Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page” combines a quick message composer and session history list on the assistant’s detail view.

items.titleZh: 为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务
items.titleEn: Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant

control.reasonZh: 「为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务」需要你在当前助理的定时任务区设定时间、提示词与启用状态，智能体也可通过定时工具协助管理。
control.reasonEn: “Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant” lets you review, add, pause, or edit scheduled prompts scoped specifically to the selected assistant workspace.

stepsZh: 从左侧「首页」的「智能体」分区点击助理卡片或「创建助理」进入（也可点侧边栏「会话」旁的「+」直接新建个人助理，或在外观设置中把「助理」固定到左侧边栏）
选择现有的主助理，或点击「创建助理」生成一位新伙伴
修改昵称、头像和气质，按需在 IDENTITY.md / SOUL.md / USER.md 中补充它的说话风格与你的个人背景（自动保存）
在页面顶部输入框直接发消息开聊，或切换到定时任务区给它安排每日早报/提醒
stepsEn: From Home, look under the Agents section to open an assistant or click Create assistant (or click + beside Sessions in the sidebar, or pin Assistant to the left sidebar in Appearance settings)
Select your Primary Assistant or click Create assistant to add a new specialized companion
Set its name, vibe, and avatar, and optionally refine IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md — changes save automatically
Send a message right from the quick input box at the top, or add a recurring briefing under its Scheduled Jobs section

capabilities.titleZh: 项目、工作区与项目资源
capabilities.summaryZh: 打开本地文件夹或远程环境建立工作区，并在专属「项目资源」页集中管理单项目的默认模型、关联目录、权限规则、定时任务与项目级智能体/技能。
capabilities.summaryEn: Open local folders or remote environments as workspaces, and use each project’s Project Resources hub to manage default models, linked directories, permission rules, scheduled jobs, and project-scoped agents or Skills.
highlightsZh: 支持打开本机目录、SSH 服务器、Docker 容器或 WSL，还可在同账号其他设备上新建项目
在「项目资源」页为单个仓库独立设置默认主力模型、快速模型与默认智能体模式
把前后端拆仓或共享库添加为「关联目录」，让文件树与智能体在同一工作区内协同读取
按项目集中查看和编辑工具审批规则、工作区定时任务、专属子智能体与项目级 Skills
highlightsEn: Open local directories, SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL distros — even on another signed-in device
Set per-project overrides for Primary model, Fast model, and default Agent mode in Project Resources
Link multi-repo frontend/backend or shared library folders as Related Directories under one workspace
Manage project-scoped permission rules, scheduled tasks, subagents, and Skills in one clean dashboard

items.titleZh: 打开现有项目目录，或通过向导创建本地与远程新项目
items.titleEn: Open an existing project folder or launch the new-project wizard for local and remote environments

items.titleZh: 在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能
items.titleEn: Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills

control.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能」需要针对你选定的具体项目工作区读取并保存覆盖项与权限规则；可在侧边栏项目行点击「项目资源」图标直接进入。
control.reasonEn: “Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills” applies to a chosen project workspace and its live host catalogs; open Project Resources from the project row in the sidebar to edit them in one place.

items.titleZh: 在多个已打开项目间自由切换、拖拽排序或关闭闲置工作区
items.titleEn: Switch, drag to reorder, or close open project workspaces in the sidebar

control.reasonZh: 排序与关闭哪个工作区取决于你在侧边栏的实时选择；智能体可帮你打开项目入口，不会擅自关闭你正在使用的工作区。
control.reasonEn: Reordering or closing workspaces depends on your live sidebar selection; the Agent can open the project flow without closing active work behind your back.

items.titleZh: 查看最近打开过的项目列表，一键重开或清理失效记录
items.titleEn: Browse recently opened projects, reopen them in one click, or clean up stale entries

control.reasonZh: 「查看最近打开过的项目列表，一键重开或清理失效记录」需要你从历史项目列表中确认要重开或清理的条目；智能体会为你打开对应入口并在界面中完成选择。
control.reasonEn: “Browse recently opened projects, reopen them in one click, or clean up stale entries” lets you inspect your recent history list and confirm which project to reopen or remove in the UI.

items.titleZh: 添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件
items.titleEn: Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files

control.reasonZh: 「添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件」涉及目录选择器、关联说明编辑及移除确认；智能体可带你定位项目入口，由你在界面中确认目录变更。
control.reasonEn: “Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files” involves folder pickers, descriptions, and unlink confirmation in Project Resources so your directory bindings stay intentional.

items.titleZh: 定制项目专属图标图案、配色或分别上传浅色/深色自定义图片
items.titleEn: Customize project icons with presets and colors, or upload separate light and dark images

control.reasonZh: 点击项目资源页的大图标，从工作学习或生活兴趣分类选择图案及颜色，或分别上传浅色、深色图片，预览后保存到工作区所属主机。
control.reasonEn: Click the large icon on the Project resources page to choose a work/study or life/hobby icon and color, or upload separate light and dark images, preview them, then save on the workspace host.

items.titleZh: 自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复
items.titleEn: Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it

control.reasonZh: 「自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复」由工作区生命周期自动维护，当你需要排查监听状态或手动重启监听时可在界面中查看与触发。
control.reasonEn: “Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it” runs automatically with your workspace lifecycle and exposes live watcher status and retry controls when troubleshooting large repos.

items.titleZh: 在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位
items.titleEn: Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content

control.reasonZh: 「在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位」面向你在文件面板与全局搜索中的实时交互检索；若你直接向智能体提问，智能体也会用内置搜索工具自行查找代码。
control.reasonEn: “Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content” powers interactive search in the file panel and Global Search while the Agent also searches your codebase directly during tasks.

items.titleZh: 直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区
items.titleEn: Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard

control.reasonZh: 「直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区」需要选择连接主机、完成认证并在远端目录浏览器中选定文件夹；智能体可打开新建项目向导供你完成连接。
control.reasonEn: “Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard” walks through host selection, authentication, and remote folder picking in the New Project dialog after the Agent opens it.

items.titleZh: 在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度
items.titleEn: Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health

control.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度」汇总了当前工作区、连接与应用运行时的实时指标，可在项目资源页和状态界面直观查看。
control.reasonEn: “Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health” aggregates live workspace, Git, and application health metrics for visual inspection in Project Resources and app status views.

stepsZh: 点击左侧边栏「会话」标题右侧的「+」（添加项目或个人助理），或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 选择「打开项目 / 新建项目」

stepsEn: Click + beside Sessions in the left sidebar (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and choose Open project / New project)
Pick a local folder, or choose an SSH host, Docker container, WSL distro, or Peer device and select its directory
Hover the project header in the sidebar: click the folder icon to open Workspace Resources (files + terminals), or click the Project Resources icon for its dashboard

capabilities.titleZh: 文件、代码编辑与多格式预览
capabilities.titleEn: Files, code editor & rich document previews
capabilities.summaryZh: 在会话旁浏览和编辑项目代码，逐文件或逐轮次审阅智能体改动并随时回滚快照，原生支持 Markdown、LaTeX 编译预览与 PDF 高亮批注审阅。
capabilities.summaryEn: Browse and edit code right beside your chat, review or roll back AI changes by file or turn, and work natively with Markdown, LaTeX PDF compilation, and annotated PDF reviews.
highlightsZh: 与会话左右并排查看文件树和代码，支持 F2 重命名、拖拽附件与一键定位系统文件夹
按单次操作、单轮对话或整个文件精细查看 Diff，逐项接受/拒绝改动或一键回滚到任意历史轮次快照
内置富文本 Markdown、实施计划阅读器、LaTeX 编译对比预览，以及带高亮/批注/手写墨迹的 PDF 审阅器
按当前语言提供器实际能力诚实呈现格式化、跳转定义、查找引用与重命名菜单，绝不展示无效空壳按钮
highlightsEn: Keep file trees and editors side by side with your session, with F2 rename, drag-and-drop attachments, and OS folder reveal
Inspect diffs by operation, turn, or file — accept or reject edits selectively, or roll back to any earlier turn snapshot
Built-in rich Markdown editor, Plan viewer, LaTeX-to-PDF compiler preview, and PDF annotation/review (Highlight, notes, Ink)
Surfaces formatting, go-to-definition, references, and rename strictly when supported by the active language provider

items.titleZh: 在左侧「工作区资源」浏览目录树，新建、读取、重命名或删除文件与文件夹
items.titleEn: Browse the Workspace Resources file tree and create, read, rename, or delete files and folders

workflowZh: 用 LS 浏览目录、Read 读取文件；创建或修改内容时使用 Write/Edit，删除时使用 Delete
重命名等文件系统动作使用工作区数据面上的 ExecCommand，并在写操作后重新读取或查看差异确认结果
workflowEn: Use LS to browse directories and Read for files; use Write or Edit for content changes and Delete for removal
Use ExecCommand on the workspace data plane for operations such as rename, then read back or inspect diffs after mutations

items.titleZh: 在分栏代码编辑器中编辑与保存文件，未保存关闭时自动弹出保护提醒
items.titleEn: Edit and save files in the split code editor with unsaved-change close protection

workflowZh: 先用 Read 读取当前内容，再根据改动范围选择 Edit 精确替换或 Write 创建/完整写入文件
文件工具沿用 OpenBitFun 的工作区、权限与变更快照语义；写入后重新读取或查看差异确认结果
workflowEn: Read the current content first, then use Edit for exact replacements or Write for creation/full rewrites
The file tools preserve OpenBitFun workspace, permission, and change-snapshot semantics; read back or inspect the diff after writing

items.titleZh: 按单个文件、单次工具操作、单轮对话或整个会话查看代码 Diff 与增删行数统计
items.titleEn: Inspect diffs and line-change stats by file, single tool operation, turn, or full session

workflowZh: 若 GetFileDiff 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载它的当前契约
按工作区、会话或目标文件读取差异，并在页面或快照变化后重新获取最新结果
workflowEn: If GetFileDiff is deferred, load its current contract with GetToolSpec first
Inspect changes for the workspace, session, or target file and refresh the result after page or snapshot changes

items.titleZh: 按单次操作、单个文件或整个会话一键「接受」或「拒绝」智能体产生的代码改动
items.titleEn: Accept or reject AI code changes by individual operation, file, or entire session

control.reasonZh: 「按单次操作、单个文件或整个会话一键「接受」或「拒绝」智能体产生的代码改动」需要你在审阅具体 Diff 后做出保留或还原的判断，可在会话修改栏与差异视图中直接点击完成。
control.reasonEn: “Accept or reject AI code changes by individual operation, file, or entire session” lets you review the concrete diff first and confirm which edits to keep or revert in the diff viewer and modified-files bar.

items.titleZh: 基于自动变更快照查看文件修改轨迹，随时把会话与代码一起回滚到指定历史轮次
items.titleEn: Browse automatic file-change snapshots and roll back a session and its files to any earlier turn

control.reasonZh: 「基于自动变更快照查看文件修改轨迹，随时把会话与代码一起回滚到指定历史轮次」会同时回退工作区文件内容与对话时间线，需要你在会话轮次上明确选择回滚节点并确认。
control.reasonEn: “Browse automatic file-change snapshots and roll back a session and its files to any earlier turn” rewinds workspace files alongside the conversation timeline, so you explicitly choose and confirm the target turn in the UI.

items.titleZh: 原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅
items.titleEn: Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink

control.reasonZh: 「原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅」面向文档阅读、排版编译与画布坐标批注等视觉交互，在工作区打开对应格式文件即可自动启用专属视图。
control.reasonEn: “Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink” activates format-aware visual editors and annotation layers automatically whenever you open Markdown, plan, LaTeX, or PDF files.

items.titleZh: 支持文件名通配与正则全文搜索，流式展示工作区匹配行与上下文
items.titleEn: Search the workspace by filename globs, plain text, or regular expressions with streaming context previews

workflowZh: 用 Glob 按路径或文件名模式查找候选文件，再用 Grep 搜索正文、正则和上下文
两者都使用当前会话的工作区数据面；远程工作区不会静默回退到本机目录
workflowEn: Use Glob for path or filename patterns, then Grep for text, regular expressions, and surrounding context
Both tools use the current session workspace data plane and never silently fall back to local paths for a remote workspace

items.titleZh: 启用本地工作区加速搜索索引，实现毫秒级大仓库内容检索
items.titleEn: Maintain accelerated local workspace search indexes for instant large-repo lookups

control.reasonZh: Glob/Grep 可直接完成智能体搜索，而界面搜索索引的启停状态归属工作区搜索设置管理。
control.reasonEn: Glob and Grep provide direct agent search, while UI search-index lifecycle is managed through workspace search settings.

items.titleZh: 仅在当前语言提供器实际支持时显示格式化、定义与类型跳转、引用、重命名、快速修复和符号导航
items.titleEn: Show formatting, definition and type navigation, references, rename, quick fixes, and symbol navigation only when supported by the active language provider

control.reasonZh: 「仅在当前语言提供器实际支持时显示格式化、定义与类型跳转、引用、重命名、快速修复和符号导航」与你在编辑器中聚焦的文件类型和光标所在符号位置绑定，可在代码编辑器右键菜单或快捷键中直接调用。
control.reasonEn: “Show formatting, definition and type navigation, references, rename, quick fixes, and symbol navigation only when supported by the active language provider” depends on the focused file type and cursor symbol in the code editor, surfaced through context menus and breadcrumbs.

items.titleZh: 在本地桌面会话中直接粘贴剪贴板截图，或把本机文件与文件夹拖进聊天框
items.titleEn: Paste clipboard images or drag local files and folders straight into Desktop sessions

control.reasonZh: 该流程需要用户选择或提供本地附件；智能体可读取已经进入会话的文件，但不会自行声称完成了用户侧拖放或剪贴板选择。
control.reasonEn: This flow requires the user to select or provide local attachments; the Agent can read files already in context without pretending it performed the user's drag, drop, or clipboard selection.

items.titleZh: 让智能体直接查看并深度分析工作区配图、UI 截图、报错图或架构草图
items.titleEn: Let the agent inspect and analyze UI screenshots, error captures, diagrams, and workspace images

workflowZh: 对本地图片先用 view_image 查看原图或高质量预览；需要结构化视觉分析时再用 analyze_image
远程或不可直接读取的图片需先通过当前工作区数据面取得，不得把远程路径静默当成本机路径
workflowEn: Use view_image for a local image preview or original view, then analyze_image when structured visual analysis is needed
Retrieve remote or otherwise inaccessible images through the active workspace data plane first; never reinterpret a remote path as local

items.titleZh: 在 Finder 或系统资源管理器中一键定位当前本机文件或文件夹
items.titleEn: Reveal any local file or folder directly in Finder or your OS file manager

control.reasonZh: 这是控制器本机的界面动作，且远程工作区路径不能回退到本机打开；智能体会打开文件入口，不会把目标机路径静默交给控制器系统。
control.reasonEn: This is a controller-local UI action, and remote-workspace paths must never fall back to the local file manager; the Agent opens the file surface without silently reusing a target-host path locally.

stepsZh: 在左侧边栏悬停项目行并点击「文件夹」图标，左侧导航会切换为该项目的「工作区资源」（上方文件树、下方终端列表）
点击任意文件即可在当前会话另一侧的分栏画布中打开；按 ⌘F / Ctrl+F 在文件内搜索，按 ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ 拆出并排编辑视图
智能体改完代码后，点击对话中的文件卡片或底部改动汇总条对比 Diff，按文件或操作点「接受 / 拒绝」
若想推翻最近几轮尝试，在对应历史轮次菜单中选择「回滚到此轮」即可一键恢复快照
stepsEn: Hover a project in the left sidebar and click its folder icon to switch into Workspace Resources (file tree on top, terminals below)
Click any file to open it in the pane opposite your active chat; use ⌘F / Ctrl+F to find in file and ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ to split editors
After the Agent edits code, click a file card or the modified-files bar to inspect diffs and Accept or Reject changes selectively
Need a clean do-over? Use Roll back to turn on any earlier message to restore your files from pre-edit snapshots
agentExamplesZh: 打开当前项目的文件面板
帮我看看这轮会话一共改了哪些文件，把核心逻辑的 Diff 总结一下
对照这张报错截图排查对应的前端组件样式问题
agentExamplesEn: Open the project file tree for me
Show me what files changed in this session and summarize the core diffs
Analyze this UI screenshot and track down the component causing the layout overflow

capabilities.titleZh: 内置终端与命令行协作
capabilities.summaryZh: 在项目目录内随时开启多实例 Shell：清晰区分「我的终端」与「智能体终端」，支持保存常用启动配置，且关掉普通终端标签页不会误杀正在运行的后台服务。
capabilities.summaryEn: Run multiple shells scoped to your local or remote workspace: separate Mine vs. Agent terminals, save reusable startup configurations, and close terminal tabs without killing running dev servers.
highlightsZh: 在左侧「工作区资源」中按「我的 / 智能体」分类管理终端，互不混杂
既可在会话右侧分栏或底部停靠面板打开终端，也可一键定位当前工作目录到文件树
关掉普通终端视图标签只会分离画面（Detach），开发服务继续稳稳运行；想彻底停掉进程再点停止/移除
在 SSH 远程工作区中新建终端时，会自动直接连入目标服务器目录执行，无需手敲 ssh
highlightsEn: Organize terminals cleanly into Mine vs. Agent views inside Workspace Resources
Dock terminals at the bottom of a chat or beside code in the split workbench, and reveal cwd in the file tree
Closing a regular terminal tab detaches the view without killing your running dev server — stop processes explicitly when ready
Opening a terminal inside an SSH remote workspace automatically spawns the shell on the remote host

items.titleZh: 打开终端视图并在当前工作区一键新建终端会话
items.titleEn: Open the terminal view and create a new shell session in the active workspace

items.titleZh: 按「我的 / 智能体」分类查看、切换终端，或保存常用的终端启动配置
items.titleEn: Browse and switch terminals across Mine and Agent views, and save reusable terminal configurations

control.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖当前终端会话列表和活动面板；智能体可直接新建终端，并可用终端工具执行任务，而多会话切换与配置管理保留在界面中完成。
control.reasonEn: These actions depend on the live terminal-session list and active panel; the Agent can create terminals and run commands via tools while multi-session management stays in the UI.

items.titleZh: 自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型
items.titleEn: Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell

control.reasonZh: 「自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型」需要读取当前主机实际安装的 Shell 列表并由你挑选目标类型，可在终端新建菜单或终端设置中完成。
control.reasonEn: “Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell” queries the shells installed on your host so you can choose one from the New Terminal menu or Terminal settings.

items.titleZh: 在文件树任意子目录右键「在此新建终端」，或让智能体在指定子目录执行命令
items.titleEn: Open a terminal directly inside any subfolder from the file tree, or let the agent run commands in a target directory

workflowZh: 调用 ExecCommand 时把目标目录放在 workdir；省略时使用当前工作区根目录
workflowEn: Pass the target directory as ExecCommand workdir; omit it to use the current workspace root

items.titleZh: 由智能体执行构建与测试命令、向交互式进程输入内容，或发送中断与停止信号
items.titleEn: Let the agent run build and test commands, send interactive stdin, or interrupt and terminate hung processes

workflowZh: 用 ExecCommand 启动命令；需要交互时启用 TTY，并保留返回的 session_id
用 WriteStdin 输入或轮询输出，用 ExecControl 发送中断或强制终止
workflowEn: Start the command with ExecCommand; enable TTY for interactive programs and keep the returned session_id
Use WriteStdin to enter text or poll output, and ExecControl to interrupt or terminate the process

items.titleZh: 在底部面板与右侧分栏间流畅拖拽调整终端尺寸，自动适配全屏 TUI 与长行排版
items.titleEn: Resize docked bottom or split-pane terminals smoothly with automatic row/column adaptation for TUI tools

control.reasonZh: 「在底部面板与右侧分栏间流畅拖拽调整终端尺寸，自动适配全屏 TUI 与长行排版」随你在工作台中拖拽面板分割线或切换窗口大小实时自动同步，无需任何手动设置。
control.reasonEn: “Resize docked bottom or split-pane terminals smoothly with automatic row/column adaptation for TUI tools” happens automatically as you drag panel splitters or resize the window in the workbench.

items.titleZh: 回溯终端命令历史并识别 Shell Integration 状态
items.titleEn: Browse terminal command history and detect Shell Integration support

control.reasonZh: 「回溯终端命令历史并识别 Shell Integration 状态」与具体终端实例的运行缓冲和 Shell 环境相关，可在终端面板中直接翻阅查看。
control.reasonEn: “Browse terminal command history and detect Shell Integration support” is tied to each live or exited terminal session in the terminal panel.

items.titleZh: 区分「关标签分离视图」与「彻底停止关闭进程」，安全关停单个或全部终端
items.titleEn: Detach views safely when closing tabs, or explicitly stop and shut down individual or all terminal processes

control.reasonZh: 「区分「关标签分离视图」与「彻底停止关闭进程」，安全关停单个或全部终端」避免误杀正在运行的服务或未保存的终端作业，由你在终端列表菜单中明确选择停止或移除。
control.reasonEn: “Detach views safely when closing tabs, or explicitly stop and shut down individual or all terminal processes” protects running dev servers and interactive jobs until you explicitly stop or close them from the terminal list.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘Shift+`（Windows/Linux 按 Ctrl+Shift+`），或点侧边栏项目行的「文件夹」图标展开「工作区资源 → 终端」
点击「+」新建终端（或在下拉箭头里挑选 zsh / PowerShell / Git Bash 等指定 Shell）
输入命令启动服务或测试；想看代码时直接关掉终端标签页，进程会在左侧终端列表继续保活
需要彻底释放端口时，在左侧「工作区资源 → 终端」对应条目菜单里点击「停止」或「移除已结束终端」
stepsEn: Press ⌘Shift+` (Ctrl+Shift+` on Windows/Linux) or click a project’s folder icon in the sidebar to open Workspace Resources → Terminals
Click + to start a shell in your project root, or use the shell picker to choose zsh, bash, PowerShell, or Git Bash
Run your dev server or tests; close the tab anytime to free screen space while keeping the underlying process alive
When you want to stop the process and free its port, choose Stop or Remove from the terminal row menu in Workspace Resources

capabilities.titleZh: OpenBitFun CLI 与终端交互界面（TUI）
capabilities.summaryZh: 在系统终端直接运行 `openbitfun`：既有快捷键顺手的全屏交互式 TUI（含 `!` Shell 模式、图片粘贴与多窗口共享运行时），也支持可写进脚本与 CI 的 `exec`、后台 `daemon` 与远程派发。
capabilities.summaryEn: Run `openbitfun` right in your system terminal: enjoy a full-featured interactive TUI (with `!` Shell mode, image paste, and `--shared` multi-terminal sessions) plus scriptable `exec`, `daemon`, `dispatch`, and stdio `server` commands.
highlightsZh: 输入 `openbitfun` 即开全功能交互式 TUI：支持 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 等全套斜杠命令
空输入框按 `!` 秒切 SHELL 模式直接跑命令，结果会作为标准对话轮次保存，回到桌面版也能看到同一张工具卡片
用 `openbitfun exec "..." --output-format text|json|stream-json` 轻松接入自动化脚本与流水线
与桌面版共用同一套配置、模型、Skills、MCP、Hooks 和会话存储，还能作为无界面的 Peer Host 或远控守护进程长驻服务器
highlightsEn: Full interactive TUI via `openbitfun`: `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, subagent tree viewer, and prompt stash
Press `!` in an empty composer for instant SHELL mode — commands save as standard turns visible in both CLI and Desktop
Scriptable `openbitfun exec` with `text`, `json`, or `stream-json` JSONL output and explicit `--auto` permission control
Shares one config, session store, MCP, Skills, and Hooks runtime with Desktop — and hosts headless Peer Mode, bots, and Cron via `daemon`

items.titleZh: 一键安装 `openbitfun` 命令行工具，并用 `doctor` 自检运行环境与配置状态
items.titleEn: Install the `openbitfun` executable and run `openbitfun doctor` to verify environment health

control.reasonZh: 「一键安装 `openbitfun` 命令行工具，并用 `doctor` 自检运行环境与配置状态」是在你的系统终端或内置终端中执行的命令行安装与环境巡检操作，智能体可为你打开终端方便直接运行。
control.reasonEn: “Install the `openbitfun` executable and run `openbitfun doctor` to verify environment health” is run directly from your terminal shell; the Agent can open the terminal surface so you can run install or doctor commands.

items.titleZh: 在交互式 TUI 中使用 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 与子智能体树检视器
items.titleEn: Work in the interactive TUI with `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, prompt stash, and subagent tree view

control.reasonZh: 「在交互式 TUI 中使用 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 与子智能体树检视器」是运行在终端中的全屏交互界面能力，启动 `openbitfun` 后即可通过斜杠命令与命令面板调出。
control.reasonEn: “Work in the interactive TUI with `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, prompt stash, and subagent tree view” is an interactive full-screen terminal session launched by running `openbitfun` in your project directory.

items.titleZh: 在空输入框按 `!` 秒进 SHELL 命令模式，或按 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴剪贴板图片与本地图片路径
items.titleEn: Type `!` on an empty prompt for SHELL mode, or press `Ctrl+V` to attach clipboard images and local image paths

control.reasonZh: 「在空输入框按 `!` 秒进 SHELL 命令模式，或按 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴剪贴板图片与本地图片路径」属于 TUI 输入框内的即时键盘交互，打开 `openbitfun` 聊天界面后即可直接使用。
control.reasonEn: “Type `!` on an empty prompt for SHELL mode, or press `Ctrl+V` to attach clipboard images and local image paths” is an immediate keyboard workflow inside the interactive TUI composer.

items.titleZh: 用 `openbitfun exec` 执行非交互式任务，输出纯文本、JSON 或流式 JSONL 并显式控制 `--auto` 审批
items.titleEn: Run non-interactive tasks with `openbitfun exec`, `--output-format text|json|stream-json`, and explicit `--auto` approval

workflowZh: 在需要脚本化调用 CLI 子命令（如 openbitfun --help 或只读状态检查）时，通过 ExecCommand 在目标工作区执行并读取标准输出
workflowEn: When invoking CLI subcommands programmatically (such as --help or read-only status checks), run them via ExecCommand in the target workspace and inspect stdout

items.titleZh: 通过 `openbitfun chat --shared` 让多个终端窗口共享同一个工作区运行时
items.titleEn: Reuse one workspace runtime across multiple terminal windows with `openbitfun chat --shared`

control.reasonZh: 「通过 `openbitfun chat --shared` 让多个终端窗口共享同一个工作区运行时」需要从多个系统终端窗口启动共享客户端会话，由你在终端环境中按需开启。
control.reasonEn: “Reuse one workspace runtime across multiple terminal windows with `openbitfun chat --shared`” is launched across your terminal windows whenever you want multi-pane TUI access to one shared runtime.

items.titleZh: 使用 `daemon` 托管远控机器人与定时任务，用 `dispatch outbound` 远程派发，或启动 `server` 标准流服务
items.titleEn: Host bots and Cron jobs via `daemon`, submit remote jobs with `dispatch outbound`, or run the stdio `server` host

control.reasonZh: 「使用 `daemon` 托管远控机器人与定时任务，用 `dispatch outbound` 远程派发，或启动 `server` 标准流服务」涵盖守护进程、跨机派发与编辑器协议宿主等命令行入口，可根据部署场景在终端中直接运行对应子命令。
control.reasonEn: “Host bots and Cron jobs via `daemon`, submit remote jobs with `dispatch outbound`, or run the stdio `server` host” provides dedicated CLI subcommands for background daemons, cross-device dispatch, and stdio JSON-RPC editor integrations.

stepsZh: 从官方发行包获取 `openbitfun`，或在仓库根目录运行 `pnpm run cli:install` 后重开一个终端窗口使 `PATH` 生效
进入任意项目目录，直接输入 `openbitfun` 启动交互式 TUI（首次使用可先跑 `openbitfun doctor` 检查环境）
在 TUI 中直接打字对话，输入 `/` 浏览 `/goal`、`/fork`、`/diff`、`/queue` 等命令，或在空行按 `!` 快速运行 Shell 命令
需要脚本化批处理时运行 `openbitfun exec "你的指令" --output-format json`；需要后台长驻远控或定时任务时启用远控渠道自动拉起 `daemon`
stepsEn: Install `openbitfun` from an official release archive or run `pnpm run cli:install` and open a fresh terminal so `PATH` updates
cd into any project directory and run `openbitfun` to launch the interactive TUI (run `openbitfun doctor` anytime to verify setup)
Chat naturally, type `/` for `/goal`, `/fork`, `/diff`, `/queue`, and `/compact`, or type `!` on an empty line for quick shell commands
Use `openbitfun exec "your prompt" --output-format json` in scripts and CI, or start Remote Connect channels so the background `daemon` stays listening after you exit

capabilities.titleZh: Git 版本控制与 Worktree 并行隔离
capabilities.summaryZh: 在会话与终端中顺畅完成状态检查、暂存提交、分支管理与 Cherry-pick，并借助 Git Worktree 在同一仓库同时并行推进多个互不干扰的 AI 会话。
capabilities.summaryEn: Inspect changes, stage, commit, manage branches, and cherry-pick through AI sessions and terminals — and use Git worktrees to run multiple parallel sessions on the same repository without branch collisions.
highlightsZh: 直接用自然语言让智能体检查变更、整理暂存、生成规范 Commit Message 并安全提交
支持分支切换、提交图谱历史追溯、查看任意历史提交中的文件内容与 Cherry-pick 挑选合并
核心利器 Git Worktree：不用克隆多份仓库，就能让两个会话在不同分支上同时改代码、跑测试互不覆盖
内置高危 Git 参数拦截与仓库信任检查，强制推送或硬重置前都会经过安全确认
highlightsEn: Ask the Agent in plain language to inspect status/diffs, stage files, draft clean commit messages, and commit safely
Manage local branches, inspect commit history and arbitrary revisions, and run or resolve cherry-picks
Git Worktree isolation: run two or more AI tasks on different branches of the same repo simultaneously with zero conflict
Built-in guardrails for force-push, hard reset, and repository trust keep destructive Git actions explicit

items.titleZh: 查看仓库工作树状态、已跟踪改动数与逐文件 Diff 详情

workflowZh: 在当前工作区通过 ExecCommand 运行 git status 与 git diff
检查当前工作树、暂存区和目标文件差异
workflowEn: Run git status and git diff through ExecCommand in the current workspace
Inspect the working tree, index, and selected file changes

items.titleZh: 管理仓库信任授权，以及创建、绑定、提升、重建和清理隔离的 Git Worktree
items.titleEn: Manage repository trust and create, bind, promote, recreate, or clean up isolated Git worktrees

control.reasonZh: 「管理仓库信任授权，以及创建、绑定、提升、重建和清理隔离的 Git Worktree」涉及仓库安全信任确认及多会话工作树生命周期管理，可在会话工作树入口或「设置 → 工作区与 Git → Worktrees」中直观操作。
control.reasonEn: “Manage repository trust and create, bind, promote, recreate, or clean up isolated Git worktrees” involves repository trust confirmation and worktree lifecycle choices managed in session worktree controls and Workspace & Git settings.

items.titleZh: 按文件精准暂存（Stage）、取消暂存或安全重置到指定提交
items.titleEn: Stage selected files, unstage changes, or reset to a chosen commit with safety checks

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git add、git restore 或 git reset
完成暂存、取消暂存和选定提交重置；危险参数仍经过权限与安全检查
workflowEn: Run git add, git restore, or git reset through ExecCommand
Stage, unstage, or reset to a selected commit; risky arguments still pass permission and safety checks

items.titleZh: 结合真实改动自动拟定规范提交说明并创建 Git Commit
items.titleEn: Generate clear commit messages from actual diffs and create commits after your review

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 先运行 git status 与 git diff
再运行 git commit 创建经用户确认的提交
workflowEn: Run git status and git diff through ExecCommand first
Then run git commit to create the user-approved commit

items.titleZh: 查看本地与远端跟踪分支，新建特性分支、切换分支或清理已合并分支
items.titleEn: List local and tracking branches, create feature branches, switch branches, or clean up merged ones

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git branch 查看、创建或删除分支
运行 git switch 或 git checkout 切换分支
workflowEn: Run git branch through ExecCommand to list, create, or delete branches
Run git switch or git checkout to change branches

items.titleZh: 从远端仓库拉取更新（Pull）并将本地提交推送到远端（Push）
items.titleEn: Pull upstream updates and push local commits to remotes with force-push protection

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git pull 或 git push 同步远端
强制推送等高风险参数仍会被拦截或要求确认
workflowEn: Run git pull or git push through ExecCommand to synchronize remotes
High-risk arguments such as force push remain blocked or require confirmation

items.titleZh: 跨分支挑选合并指定提交（Cherry-pick），并支持冲突后继续或安全中止
items.titleEn: Start, continue, or cleanly abort a Git cherry-pick across branches

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git cherry-pick
使用 --continue 或 --abort 继续或中止流程
workflowEn: Run git cherry-pick through ExecCommand
Use --continue or --abort to continue or cancel the operation

items.titleZh: 检索提交历史与演进脉络，快速定位引入回归问题的提交（git log / blame）
items.titleEn: Explore commit history and graphs to pinpoint when a behavior or regression was introduced

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git log 或 git show 读取提交图谱与历史
界面的最近访问记录仍由 Git 场景保存；智能体读取历史不会伪装成修改该 UI 状态
workflowEn: Run git log or git show through ExecCommand to inspect the commit graph and history
Recent-history UI state remains owned by the Git surface; reading history does not pretend to mutate that presentation state

items.titleZh: 解析任意分支、Tag 或 Commit SHA，直接对比或读取历史版本中的文件内容
items.titleEn: Resolve any branch, tag, or commit SHA and read historical file contents without checking out

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git show
解析 revision 并读取指定提交中的对象或文件内容
workflowEn: Run git show through ExecCommand
Resolve a revision and inspect objects or file content from a selected commit

stepsZh: 在项目会话中直接告诉智能体你的 Git 诉求（如「看看当前改了哪些文件」「基于 main 切一个修复分支」），或在内置终端 / CLI 中输入 `/diff` 查看变更
想同时跑两个互不干扰的任务时，为新会话启用 Worktree 隔离（可在侧边栏会话筛选器中按「主工作区 / 工作树会话」分类查看）
开发完成后，点击会话改动条逐文件审阅 Diff，再让智能体按仓库风格拟定提交信息并完成本地 Commit
确认无误后再明确指令智能体执行 `git push` 或使用 `commit-push-pr` 技能一气呵成发起 PR
stepsEn: Tell the Agent in chat what you want to do in Git ("Show unstaged changes", "Create a fix branch off main"), or run `/diff` in the CLI
When running parallel tasks on one repo, create a Worktree-isolated session (and filter Main vs. Worktree sessions anytime in the sidebar view menu)
Review per-file diffs in the session’s modified-files bar, then ask the Agent to draft a commit message and create the commit
Once satisfied, explicitly ask the Agent to push or invoke the built-in `commit-push-pr` Skill to open a pull request
agentExamplesZh: 看看当前仓库有哪些未提交的改动，帮我把日志调试代码剔除后整理一次干净提交
帮我把 commit a1b2c3d cherry-pick 到当前分支，如果有冲突先列给我看
查一下最近两周是谁、在哪次提交里改了 token 刷新的超时逻辑
agentExamplesEn: Check git status and diff, strip any leftover debug logs, and stage a clean commit with a descriptive message
Cherry-pick commit a1b2c3d onto my current branch and walk me through any conflicts
Search recent git history to find which commit changed the token refresh timeout logic

capabilities.titleZh: 深度代码评审（Deep Review）与 Pull Request
capabilities.summaryZh: 一站读取 GitHub / GitLab / GitCode / Gitee 的 PR 改动、关联 Issue 与失败的 CI 运行日志，并可调度多角色评审团队对本地修改、指定提交或远端 PR 进行严格结构化审查。
capabilities.summaryEn: Load pull request diffs, linked issues, and failing CI logs from GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, or Gitee — and launch multi-agent Deep Review against local edits, commits, or PRs.
highlightsZh: 原生对接 GitHub（复用本机 `gh` 登录）、GitLab、GitCode 与 Gitee，直接拉取 PR 详情与代码变更
CI 挂了不用来回切网页翻几千行构建输出：直接读取对应 CI 任务日志精准定位报错根因
一键发起多智能体「Deep Review（严格审查）」，由多个评审工种分头挑刺再经质量门过滤误报，输出可定位的结构化问题单
写代码收尾时自动比对变更上下文，生成清晰达意的提交说明与 PR 概要
highlightsEn: Works natively with GitHub (reusing local `gh` CLI auth), GitLab, GitCode, and Gitee to read PR diffs and discussions
Pull failing CI job logs straight into your session to diagnose broken builds without hunting through web logs
Run multi-agent Deep Review against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a PR — complete with quality-gate filtering to cut false positives
Generate clean commit messages and PR summaries grounded in your actual diff and linked issue context

items.titleZh: 针对本地未提交改动、指定 Commit 或远端 PR 发起多角色 Deep Review 结构化审查
items.titleEn: Run multi-agent Deep Review against uncommitted workspace changes, a commit, or a pull request

workflowZh: 用 LaunchReviewAgent 按已确认的工作区、提交或 PR 目标启动专门评审智能体，并等待其发现
评审智能体用 submit_code_review 提交结构化问题；队列管理和人工查看仍可打开 Deep Review 场景
workflowEn: Launch a specialist review agent with LaunchReviewAgent for the confirmed workspace, commit, or PR target and wait for findings
Review agents submit structured findings with submit_code_review; queue management and human inspection remain available in the Deep Review surface

items.titleZh: 分页读取 Pull Request / Merge Request 的描述、评论讨论与关联代码改动
items.titleEn: Read pull-request descriptions, review threads, and paged file changes directly in context

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
调用 get_pull_request 或 get_pull_request_detail_page 读取 PR 概览、分页详情与改动
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
Call get_pull_request or get_pull_request_detail_page to inspect PR overview, paged detail, and changes

items.titleZh: 一键拉取 PR 失败或运行中的 CI 任务日志，快速定位构建与测试报错
items.titleEn: Fetch CI run logs for a pull request to pinpoint build, lint, or test failures

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
先读取 PR/CI 条目，再用 get_pull_request_ci_log 获取对应运行日志
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
Read the PR/CI entries first, then use get_pull_request_ci_log for the selected run log

items.titleZh: 自动识别当前仓库的 Git 远端地址、分支快照与对应的评审平台目标
items.titleEn: Detect the active repository’s remotes, branch snapshot, and matching review-platform target automatically

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
调用 get_workspace_snapshot 或 list_remotes 读取当前仓库、远端与评审目标
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
Call get_workspace_snapshot or list_remotes to load the current repository, remotes, and review target

items.titleZh: 读取关联 Issue 的需求背景、验收标准与讨论上下文
items.titleEn: Load linked Issue titles, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and discussion context

control.reasonZh: 「读取关联 Issue 的需求背景、验收标准与讨论上下文」与评审面板中选定的仓库及 Issue 编号联动，可在查看 PR 与评审详情时一并展开核对。
control.reasonEn: “Load linked Issue titles, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and discussion context” connects to the selected repository and issue reference inside your review workflow.

items.titleZh: 对接本机 GitHub CLI（`gh`）登录态，或安全保存/清除 GitLab、GitCode 与 Gitee 访问令牌
items.titleEn: Reuse local GitHub CLI (`gh`) login or securely store and clear GitLab, GitCode, and Gitee access tokens

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
GitHub 使用本机 gh 登录；仅在用户明确提供时，才用 update_auth_token/clear_auth_token 管理 GitLab、GitCode 或 Gitee 凭据
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
GitHub uses local gh authentication; only use update_auth_token/clear_auth_token for GitLab, GitCode, or Gitee when the user explicitly provides or clears credentials

items.titleZh: 一键预览、生成或快速填充贴合改动的提交信息
items.titleEn: Preview, generate, or quick-fill commit messages tailored to your staged changes

control.reasonZh: 「一键预览、生成或快速填充贴合改动的提交信息」需要结合当前工作区暂存改动并在提交输入框中由你过目确认或微调文案。
control.reasonEn: “Preview, generate, or quick-fill commit messages tailored to your staged changes” drafts a commit message from your current changes so you can review and tweak the wording before committing.

stepsZh: 若使用 GitHub 仓库，先确保本机已安装并登录 `gh`（未登录时可按界面提示一键打开终端完成 `gh auth login`）；GitLab / GitCode / Gitee 准备好访问令牌即可
评审本地代码：在会话中直接说「对当前未提交改动发起 Deep Review」或指定某个 Commit
评审或排查远端 PR：直接发送 PR 编号或链接（如「查看 PR #42 的失败 CI 日志并修复」）
逐条查看结构化评审结论，点击问题定位到对应代码行，或让智能体直接按评审意见完成修复与复测
stepsEn: For GitHub repos, ensure `gh` CLI is signed in (or use the one-click terminal prompt for `gh auth login`); for GitLab, GitCode, or Gitee, provide an access token when prompted
To review local work: ask in chat to "Run Deep Review on my current uncommitted changes" (or name a specific commit)
To inspect or fix a PR: mention the PR number or URL (e.g., "Check why CI failed on PR #42 and fix the root cause")
Walk through the consolidated findings by severity, jump to files, or ask the Agent to apply fixes and re-verify
agentExamplesZh: 对当前分支相对于 main 的全部改动做一次严格的 Deep Review
帮我看看当前分支关联的 PR 为什么 CI 挂了，把报错原因和修复方案列出来
阅读 PR #86 的改动和关联 Issue，检查有没有遗漏边界情况
agentExamplesEn: Run a thorough Deep Review on all changes in my current branch against main
Check why CI failed on the PR for this branch and propose a fix
Read PR #86 and its linked issue to verify whether any edge cases were missed

capabilities.summaryZh: 在会话旁并排预览本地开发服务与文档网页：点一下「元素选择器」就能把页面上的 DOM 节点抓进聊天框改样式，也能让智能体直接在页面上点击、填表、滚动和截图验证。
capabilities.summaryEn: Preview local dev servers and web pages right beside your chat: click any DOM node with the Element Picker to send its exact selector and HTML into your prompt, or let the agent click, fill forms, scroll, and capture screenshots.
highlightsZh: 前端开发神器：左边对话改代码，右边实时预览 `localhost` 页面，无需在两个软件间频繁切屏
点开「元素选择器」悬停点击页面上任意按钮或卡片，自动把它的标签、CSS 路径与 HTML 塞进当前输入框上下文
智能体可读页面、点按钮、填表单、滚屏与截图自测 UI，与外部 Chrome/Edge（CDP）共用同一套动作契约
需要复用你平时浏览器里已登录的账号 Cookie 时，可无缝切换到设置中已授权连接的外部浏览器操作
highlightsEn: Frontend superpower: keep `localhost` live beside your chat so you never have to alt-tab while tweaking UI
Use the Element Picker to click any component on the page and drop its exact CSS path, attributes, and HTML straight into your prompt
Let the Agent snapshot, click, fill forms, scroll, and verify UI changes — sharing one BrowserActions contract with external CDP browsers
Need your signed-in cookies? Seamlessly target the external Chrome/Edge browser you authorized in Settings

items.titleZh: 输入完整网址、本地域名或开发服务端口并在 OpenBitFun 内打开
items.titleEn: Open full URLs, local hostnames, or development-service ports inside OpenBitFun

workflowZh: 用户给出网址时，用 browser.navigate（target=builtin）直接打开，缺少页面时自动创建；需要读取或交互时附带 observe=article 或 snapshot，并复用返回的 session_id；用户只要求显示内置浏览器且没有网址时，改用 OpenBitFunControl 打开 feature.browser 能力根入口，不得臆造 about:blank
对同一个 session_id 指定 target 为 builtin；选择已打开页面时，用 browser.connect 和唯一匹配的 target_url 或 target_title；快照、点击、填写、滚动和截图等动作与外部 CDP 浏览器共用同一套契约
复用 navigate 返回的观察结果，只在下一步需要新页面状态时重新快照；涉及用户账号登录态时，优先使用用户在设置中已授权连接的 external 浏览器，未授权时请用户连接，不得自行开启权限；CDP 协议扩展同样需要可用的外接连接
workflowEn: When the user supplies a URL, use browser.navigate with target=builtin (creates a page when needed), add observe=article or snapshot for reading/interaction, and keep the returned session_id; when they only want the built-in browser surface, open the feature.browser capability root with OpenBitFunControl and never invent about:blank
Address that session_id with target set to builtin; to select an existing page, use browser.connect with a unique target_url or target_title match. Portable actions share the external CDP contract

Reuse the observation returned by navigate; refresh only when the next decision needs new page state. For account/login-dependent work, prefer the external browser the user authorized in Settings; if unavailable, ask the user to connect it and never enable permissions yourself. CDP extensions also require an available external connection

workflowZh: 用户给出网址时，用 browser.navigate（target=builtin）直接打开，缺少页面时自动创建；需要读取或交互时附带 observe=article 或 snapshot，并复用返回的 session_id；用户只要求显示内置浏览器且没有网址时，改用 OpenBitFunControl 打开 feature.browser 能力根入口，不得臆造 about:blank

复用 navigate 返回的观察结果，只在下一步需要新页面状态时重新快照；涉及用户账号登录态时，优先使用用户在设置中已授权连接的 external 浏览器，未授权时请用户连接，不得自行开启权限；CDP 协议扩展同样需要可用的外接连接
workflowEn: When the user supplies a URL, use browser.navigate with target=builtin (creates a page when needed), add observe=article or snapshot for reading/interaction, and keep the returned session_id; when they only want the built-in browser surface, open the feature.browser capability root with OpenBitFunControl and never invent about:blank
Address that session_id with target set to builtin; to select an existing page, use browser.connect with a unique target_url or target_title match. Portable actions share the external CDP contract

Reuse the observation returned by navigate; refresh only when the next decision needs new page state. For account/login-dependent work, prefer the external browser the user authorized in Settings; if unavailable, ask the user to connect it and never enable permissions yourself. CDP extensions also require an available external connection

capabilities.summaryZh: 让智能体连接你平时用的 Chrome / Edge 等外部浏览器（直接复用已登录的网页账号），或在你的明确授权下共享指定应用窗口与桌面画面，完成截图观察、点击、输入和滚动操作，并提供实时预览卡片与一键急停。
capabilities.summaryEn: Let agents connect to your everyday Chrome or Edge browser (reusing signed-in web sessions) or, with explicit authorization, share a specific App window or screen to inspect, click, type, and scroll—complete with a live preview card and instant stop.
highlightsZh: 一键探测并连接 Chrome / Edge 等外部 CDP 浏览器，无缝复用你的已登录网页状态
引导检查并跳转系统「辅助功能」与「屏幕录制」隐私权限，状态透明清晰
支持只共享单个 App 窗口而非整块屏幕，先选窗口再授权输入，安全可控
会话内展示实时控制预览卡片与虚拟指针位置，随时一键停止并释放控制权
highlightsEn: Discover and connect Chrome, Edge, and other CDP browsers to work with already signed-in web apps
Check OS Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions clearly and jump straight to system settings
Share a single application window instead of your whole screen, granting view and input separately
Watch a live authorized preview card with virtual pointer feedback in chat, and stop control anytime in one click

items.titleZh: 一键检查桌面控制可用性及「辅助功能」「屏幕录制」授权状态
items.titleEn: Check Computer Use availability plus Accessibility and Screen Recording status

control.reasonZh: 「一键检查桌面控制可用性及「辅助功能」「屏幕录制」授权状态」会实时读取当前系统的图形会话与隐私授权状态；智能体会为你直接打开「浏览器与桌面控制」设置页核对。
control.reasonEn: "Check Computer Use availability plus Accessibility and Screen Recording status" reads live graphical-session and OS privacy state; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings so you can review each check.

items.titleZh: 在界面内一键触发桌面控制所需的操作系统权限申请
items.titleEn: Request required operating-system permissions for desktop control

control.reasonZh: 「在界面内一键触发桌面控制所需的操作系统权限申请」必须由本机用户在操作系统原生权限弹窗中亲自确认；智能体会打开授权设置入口但绝不能代你越权开启。
control.reasonEn: "Request required operating-system permissions for desktop control" must be confirmed personally in the operating system’s native consent prompt; the Agent opens the setup page and never grants permissions itself.

items.titleZh: 直达系统「隐私与安全性」对应设置面板
items.titleEn: Jump straight to the matching OS Privacy & Security settings pane

control.reasonZh: 「直达系统「隐私与安全性」对应设置面板」会唤起操作系统的外部系统设置窗口供你手动勾选开关；智能体会为你打开对应的控制设置页触发跳转。
control.reasonEn: "Jump straight to the matching OS Privacy & Security settings pane" opens your operating system’s external Settings app for manual toggling; the Agent opens the control settings entry so you can launch it.

items.titleZh: 自动发现本机受支持的浏览器并查看实时 CDP 连接状态
items.titleEn: Discover installed supported browsers and inspect live CDP connection status

control.reasonZh: 「自动发现本机受支持的浏览器并查看实时 CDP 连接状态」依赖实时扫描本机浏览器进程与调试端口状态；智能体会打开设置页展示当前检测到的浏览器列表。
control.reasonEn: "Discover installed supported browsers and inspect live CDP connection status" scans local browser installations and live debugging ports; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings to display the detected list.

items.titleZh: 启动受控浏览器，或随时连接 / 断开已开启 CDP 的浏览器
items.titleEn: Launch browser control, or connect to and disconnect from a CDP-enabled browser

control.reasonZh: 「启动受控浏览器，或随时连接 / 断开已开启 CDP 的浏览器」涉及你日常浏览器的连接授权与会话切换；智能体会为你打开「浏览器与桌面控制」页面由你点击连接或断开。
control.reasonEn: "Launch browser control, or connect to and disconnect from a CDP-enabled browser" controls live access to your personal browser session; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings so you can connect or disconnect explicitly.

items.titleZh: 一键配置默认 CDP 远程调试参数并按需优雅重启浏览器
items.titleEn: Enable default CDP debugging setup and restart the browser when needed

control.reasonZh: 「一键配置默认 CDP 远程调试参数并按需优雅重启浏览器」重启浏览器可能影响你当前打开的网页标签，必须由你在界面确认后执行；智能体会打开对应设置入口。
control.reasonEn: "Enable default CDP debugging setup and restart the browser when needed" restarting your browser affects open tabs and requires your explicit confirmation; the Agent opens the setup panel so you decide when to restart.

items.titleZh: 获权后由智能体完成画面读取、元素定位、点击、输入与滚动
items.titleEn: Let authorized agents capture, locate elements, click, type, and scroll

workflowZh: 先让 ComputerUse 检查当前可用动作和授权；缺少系统权限时明确引导用户授权
授权后使用最新截图或元素定位结果执行点击、输入、滚动和可见界面读取
workflowEn: Ask ComputerUse to inspect available actions and permissions first; surface missing operating-system permissions explicitly
After authorization, use the latest screenshot or element-location result to click, type, scroll, and inspect the visible interface

items.titleZh: 在会话控制卡片中实时查看当前受控目标、模式与授权画面预览
items.titleEn: Watch the current target, control mode, and live capture preview in the session card

control.reasonZh: 「在会话控制卡片中实时查看当前受控目标、模式与授权画面预览」需要当前存在活动的桌面控制会话并在界面展开控制卡片查看（预览仅限已授权目标与虚拟指针，远程设备不会回退截取控制端本机画面）。
control.reasonEn: "Watch the current target, control mode, and live capture preview in the session card" requires an active control session and expanding the live card in chat (the preview shows only the authorized target and virtual pointer, without local fallback on remote hosts).

items.titleZh: 随时一键停止桌面控制会话并立即释放截图与输入占用
items.titleEn: Stop the active desktop-control session immediately and release all resources

workflowZh: 通过 ComputerUse control_status 确认当前会话的目标、所有者与模式；没有活动会话时不要启动新会话
使用 ComputerUse stop_control 释放该工具拥有的会话；用户也可在执行端控制卡片点击停止，按钮只针对显示的会话代次，不停止后来创建的会话
workflowEn: Use ComputerUse control_status to inspect the current target, owner, and mode; do not start a session when none is active

Use ComputerUse stop_control to release the tool-owned session. Users can also stop from the executing Desktop control card; its button addresses the displayed generation rather than a subsequently created session.

items.titleZh: 按单个 App 窗口精细共享，先确认画面再独立授权键鼠控制
items.titleEn: Share an individual App window and grant or revoke input control separately

control.reasonZh: 共享窗口及控制模式由用户明确选择；智能体只能请求共享，不能代替用户授权。
control.reasonEn: Window selection and input mode require an explicit user choice; agents can request sharing but cannot grant themselves control.

items.titleZh: 直接在共享预览画面中点击、拖拽、滚动与输入交互
items.titleEn: Click, drag, scroll, and type directly through the authorized shared preview

control.reasonZh: 预览输入需要用户授权，并绑定共享窗口、图像坐标及授权版本。
control.reasonEn: Preview input requires user authorization and is bound to the shared window, image coordinates and authorization revision.

items.titleZh: 按应用可执行文件与控制模式记住常用授权，或随时撤销记忆
items.titleEn: Remember or revoke control grants per application executable and input mode

control.reasonZh: 记住授权只在用户选定并共享同一应用后生效，应用文件或输入模式改变时需要重新授权。
control.reasonEn: Remembered control applies only after the user shares the same application; changed executable contents or input modes require a new grant.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘, / Ctrl+, 打开设置，进入「工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制」
若需操控外部浏览器：在「浏览器控制」区域选择已安装的浏览器，按提示启用默认 CDP 调试端口并连接（必要时按提示重启浏览器）
若需操控桌面或原生应用：开启桌面控制并按引导在系统设置中授予「辅助功能」与「屏幕录制」权限
在会话中发起任务后，选择要共享的 App 窗口与输入模式；执行期间可在聊天控制卡片查看画面预览，或随时点击「停止」收回控制
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control
For external browser automation: pick your installed browser, enable default CDP setup (restarting the browser if prompted), and connect
For desktop/app control: enable Computer Use and grant OS Accessibility and Screen Recording access via the one-click system settings buttons
When an agent requests access in chat, pick the target App window and input mode; monitor the live preview card or click Stop anytime

Use ComputerUse stop_control to release the tool-owned session. Users can also stop from the executing Desktop control card; its button addresses the displayed generation rather than a subsequently created session.

capabilities.summaryZh: 把领域经验、团队代码规范、排查套路和辅助脚本封装成可复用的 Skill。既能从技能市场一键安装，也能放在项目仓库里随团队共享，或在对话中通过 $、/ 与 @ 随时点名调用。
capabilities.summaryEn: Turn domain know-how, team conventions, debugging playbooks, and helper scripts into reusable Skills—install from the Marketplace, commit project-scoped Skills with your repo, or invoke them on demand with $, /, or @ in chat.
highlightsZh: 内置精选技能（如视觉皮肤设计 openbitfun-skin-designer、PPT 设计、提交与 PR 等）开箱即用
逛技能市场一键安装，或直接导入本地 SKILL.md 文件夹到个人全局或当前项目
支持在对话中输入 $、句中输入 / 或用 @ 菜单直接点名调用指定技能
支持全局开关与按智能体模式（如 Standard、Creative）精细分配可用技能组
highlightsEn: Ships with built-in Skills out of the box (including openbitfun-skin-designer, ppt-design, debug, and commit-push-pr)
Install community Skills from the Marketplace or add local SKILL.md folders at user or project scope
Trigger a Skill directly in chat with $, mid-sentence /, or the @ context menu, or let agents load matching Skills automatically
Toggle Skills globally or tailor which Skills and skill groups each Agent mode can access

items.titleZh: 集中浏览内置、个人全局、当前项目与外部导入的全部已安装 Skills
items.titleEn: Browse built-in, user, project, and imported Skills in one unified catalog

control.reasonZh: 「集中浏览内置、个人全局、当前项目与外部导入的全部已安装 Skills」支持按来源筛选、搜索与查看扫描诊断详情；智能体会直接为你打开已安装技能目录。
control.reasonEn: "Browse built-in, user, project, and imported Skills in one unified catalog" supports source filtering, live search, and scan-diagnostic inspection; the Agent opens the Installed Skills catalog directly for you.

items.titleZh: 逛 Skill 市场：搜索、分类浏览与刷新社区精选技能
items.titleEn: Explore, search, and refresh community workflows in the Skill Market

control.reasonZh: 「逛 Skill 市场：搜索、分类浏览与刷新社区精选技能」需要你结合任务偏好浏览和挑选合适的市场条目；智能体会为你打开「发现技能」市场视图。
control.reasonEn: "Explore, search, and refresh community workflows in the Skill Market" lets you browse descriptions and pick workflows that match your needs; the Agent opens the Discover Skills marketplace view for you.

items.titleZh: 将市场中的 Skill 一键安装到个人全局或当前项目
items.titleEn: Install a Marketplace Skill to your user profile or active project

control.reasonZh: 「将市场中的 Skill 一键安装到个人全局或当前项目」需要你确认安装目标（个人全局还是当前项目工作区）；智能体会打开市场入口交由你一键确认安装。
control.reasonEn: "Install a Marketplace Skill to your user profile or active project" requires choosing whether to install at user scope or into the current project; the Agent opens the market listing so you can confirm.

items.titleZh: 校验本地文件夹（含 SKILL.md）并添加为个人或项目 Skill
items.titleEn: Validate a local SKILL.md folder and add it at user or project scope

control.reasonZh: 「校验本地文件夹（含 SKILL.md）并添加为个人或项目 Skill」需要选择本地技能目录、查看校验反馈并选定作用范围；智能体会打开添加技能向导供你完成操作。
control.reasonEn: "Validate a local SKILL.md folder and add it at user or project scope" requires picking a folder, reviewing validation results, and choosing user or project scope; the Agent opens the Add Skill dialog for you.

items.titleZh: 安全移除不再需要的个人级或项目级已安装 Skill
items.titleEn: Remove an installed user-level or project-level Skill safely

control.reasonZh: 「安全移除不再需要的个人级或项目级已安装 Skill」属于删除操作，需要你在技能列表中核对来源并二次确认，防止误删项目共享技能。
control.reasonEn: "Remove an installed user-level or project-level Skill safely" is a destructive action that requires verifying the Skill’s scope and confirming deletion in the catalog.

items.titleZh: 在全局一键启用或暂时停用某个 Skill，无需卸载
items.titleEn: Enable or temporarily disable any Skill globally without uninstalling it

control.reasonZh: 「在全局一键启用或暂时停用某个 Skill，无需卸载」依赖你查看当前技能列表状态并选择要切换的具体条目；智能体会打开技能管理页供你直接点按开关。
control.reasonEn: "Enable or temporarily disable any Skill globally without uninstalling it" depends on inspecting your installed list and toggling the target entry; the Agent opens the Skills page so you can flip the switch.

items.titleZh: 按智能体模式（如 Standard、Creative）定制可用 Skill 组合并支持恢复默认
items.titleEn: Customize which Skills and skill groups each Agent mode can use, with one-click reset

control.reasonZh: 「按智能体模式（如 Standard、Creative）定制可用 Skill 组合并支持恢复默认」涉及对比不同模式的技能矩阵与分组勾选；智能体会打开对应配置界面供你精细调整或恢复默认。
control.reasonEn: "Customize which Skills and skill groups each Agent mode can use, with one-click reset" involves picking across mode-specific Skill groups and overrides; the Agent opens the configuration view so you can tune or reset selections.

items.titleZh: 自动按「项目级优先于个人级」处理同名 Skill 并在界面提示遮蔽关系
items.titleEn: Automatically prioritize project Skills over same-named user Skills with clear badges

control.reasonZh: 「自动按「项目级优先于个人级」处理同名 Skill 并在界面提示遮蔽关系」用于在界面查看同名技能的来源层级与实际生效版本；智能体会打开技能列表让你直观核对遮蔽详情。
control.reasonEn: "Automatically prioritize project Skills over same-named user Skills with clear badges" surfaces scope precedence and shadowed-item badges directly in the catalog UI; the Agent opens the Skills list so you can inspect them.

items.titleZh: 在会话中由智能体按需自动加载或响应 $ 点名执行可见 Skill
items.titleEn: Load and follow a visible Skill on demand or via $ mention in chat

workflowZh: 只有任务匹配且 Skill 对当前智能体可见时才调用 Skill；先读取完整 SKILL.md，再按其约束执行
Skill 的安装、删除和全局启停仍通过 Skills 场景管理，执行工具不会伪装成包管理器
workflowEn: Call Skill only when the task matches and it is visible to the current agent; read the complete SKILL.md before following it
Installation, removal, and global enablement remain owned by the Skills surface; the execution tool does not pretend to be a package manager

Download a Skill from the Market to user or project scope, or click Add Skill to validate and link a local SKILL.md folder

Describe your task naturally so the agent loads matching Skills on demand, or type $skill-name (or @ → Skills) in chat to invoke one explicitly
