capabilities.summaryZh: 在 OpenBitFun 内逛市场安装现成效率小工具，或用自然语言让智能体直接为你写一个带独立界面、本地持久存储、Node/JS 后台 Worker 和内置 AI 对话能力的小应用——支持草稿实时改版、版本回滚，还能发布分享到市场。
capabilities.summaryEn: Install ready-made tools from the Mini App Market, or ask an agent in plain language to build a lightweight app with its own UI, persistent storage, background Worker, and embedded AI—complete with live customization drafts, version rollback, and market publishing.
highlightsZh: 一句话从零创建或修改小应用，客户端内置编译保存，无需你手动建工程配打包器
逛小应用市场一键安装、更新、收藏与评分，或从本地包直接导入
每个小应用拥有独立标签页、持久存储、按需授权的工作区路径访问与专属 AI 会话
支持定制草稿隔离预览与多版本历史一键回滚，打磨成熟后可提交到市场分享
highlightsEn: Create or update Mini Apps from a plain-language prompt—compiled and saved directly inside OpenBitFun without external build setup
Browse the Mini App Market to install, update, favorite, and rate community apps, or import local packages
Run each app in its own tab with isolated storage, explicit path/workspace permissions, background workers, and embedded AI calls
Customize safely in isolated drafts, roll back to any prior version, and submit polished apps to the Market

items.titleZh: 列出、查看源码、直接创建、增量更新或删除已安装小应用
items.titleEn: List, inspect source, create, update, or delete installed Mini Apps

items.titleZh: 浏览小应用市场、查看应用详情与包信息，一键安装或升级版本
items.titleEn: Browse the Mini App Market, inspect listings, and install or update releases

control.reasonZh: 「浏览小应用市场、查看应用详情与包信息，一键安装或升级版本」需要你浏览市场卡片、核对应用说明与权限范围后确认安装；智能体会为你直接打开小应用市场。
control.reasonEn: "Browse the Mini App Market, inspect listings, and install or update releases" lets you browse listings, review permissions, and confirm installation; the Agent opens the Mini App gallery directly for you.

items.titleZh: 登录市场账号，收藏喜欢的小应用、打分评价并查看安装来源
items.titleEn: Sign in to favorite and rate Market apps and track installed origins

control.reasonZh: 市场登录必须由用户在外部认证流程中确认；智能体可以打开准确入口，但不能代替账户持有人完成认证。
control.reasonEn: Market sign-in requires the account holder to confirm an external authentication flow; the Agent can open the exact entry but cannot complete that authentication for them.

items.titleZh: 按具体文件夹或工作区精细授权，并在应用定制前审查权限变更
items.titleEn: Grant scoped folder or workspace access and review permission diffs before applying

control.reasonZh: 「按具体文件夹或工作区精细授权，并在应用定制前审查权限变更」涉及文件系统访问边界与安全授权决策，必须由你在界面亲自核对路径与权限差异后确认。
control.reasonEn: "Grant scoped folder or workspace access and review permission diffs before applying" governs filesystem access boundaries and requires your explicit review of path scopes and permission diffs in the UI.

items.titleZh: 运行小应用前端与后台 Worker、自动安装依赖并管理运行状态
items.titleEn: Run Mini App UI and background Workers, manage dependencies, and stop workers

control.reasonZh: 「运行小应用前端与后台 Worker、自动安装依赖并管理运行状态」绑定正在运行的小应用实例生命周期与后台 Worker 控制；智能体会打开小应用管理面供你查看运行中状态或停止任务。
control.reasonEn: "Run Mini App UI and background Workers, manage dependencies, and stop workers" tracks live Mini App instances and background Worker lifecycles; the Agent opens the Mini Apps surface so you can inspect or stop running workers.

items.titleZh: 为正式版小应用与定制草稿分别提供互不干扰的持久化存储
items.titleEn: Persist app state separately for installed Mini Apps and customization drafts

control.reasonZh: 「为正式版小应用与定制草稿分别提供互不干扰的持久化存储」属于应用内部运行时的状态读写隔离机制；智能体会打开对应小应用让你直接在界面中使用并保存数据。
control.reasonEn: "Persist app state separately for installed Mini Apps and customization drafts" is managed automatically by each app’s runtime storage sandbox; the Agent opens the Mini App so you can view and edit your saved state.

items.titleZh: 在小应用内部直接调用大模型补全、流式对话与专属智能体会话
items.titleEn: Power Mini Apps with built-in model completions, chat streams, and agent sessions

control.reasonZh: 「在小应用内部直接调用大模型补全、流式对话与专属智能体会话」由小应用内部界面触发实时流式生成与会话交互；智能体会为你打开对应小应用体验内置 AI 能力。
control.reasonEn: "Power Mini Apps with built-in model completions, chat streams, and agent sessions" runs interactively inside the Mini App’s own interface; the Agent opens the Mini App so you can use its embedded AI features.

items.titleZh: 开启定制草稿边改边实时预览，满意后再应用或随时丢弃草稿
items.titleEn: Create live customization drafts to preview edits before applying or discarding

control.reasonZh: 「开启定制草稿边改边实时预览，满意后再应用或随时丢弃草稿」涉及草稿与正式版并排预览对比及最终应用/丢弃确认；智能体会打开小应用定制视图供你把关效果。
control.reasonEn: "Create live customization drafts to preview edits before applying or discarding" lets you preview visual changes live before committing or discarding the draft; the Agent opens the customization view for your review.

items.titleZh: 浏览小应用的每次修改版本历史，随时一键回滚到旧版本
items.titleEn: Browse Mini App version history and roll back to an earlier release anytime

control.reasonZh: 「浏览小应用的每次修改版本历史，随时一键回滚到旧版本」需要你从历史版本号列表中选定回退目标并确认回滚；智能体会打开应用详情的历史面板供你选择。
control.reasonEn: "Browse Mini App version history and roll back to an earlier release anytime" requires choosing a target revision from version history and confirming the rollback; the Agent opens the app’s version panel for you.

items.titleZh: 由智能体包办受管草稿初始化、前后端编写与构建清单校验
items.titleEn: Let an agent scaffold, author, compile, and validate a complete Mini App

workflowZh: 先用 InitMiniApp 创建受管草稿并取得工作目录，再用 Read/Write/Edit 实现应用
完成后调用 FinalizeMiniApp 校验清单、构建产物与权限，只有通过后才视为可用
workflowEn: Initialize a managed draft and obtain its workspace with InitMiniApp, then implement it with Read, Write, and Edit
Run FinalizeMiniApp to validate the manifest, build output, and permissions; treat it as usable only after validation succeeds

items.titleZh: 在你的明确要求下，由智能体整理发布说明并提交小应用到市场审核
items.titleEn: Ask an agent to package release notes and submit your Mini App for Market review

workflowZh: 仅在用户明确要求对外提交时调用 PublishMiniApp，并提供已完成应用、许可与发布说明
登录、校验或上传返回可恢复状态时，向用户展示具体下一步，不把待授权或待审核状态报告成发布成功
workflowEn: Call PublishMiniApp only after an explicit request to submit externally, with the completed app, license, and release notes
When authentication, validation, or upload returns a resumable state, show the exact next step and never report pending authorization or review as published

items.titleZh: 让智能体读懂小应用源码并直接在当前窗口帮你交互操作
items.titleEn: Let an agent understand a Mini App’s source and operate its live UI for you

workflowZh: 先用 OpenBitFunControl 的 get 查询 feature.miniapps，并按 schema 用 inspect-app 读取源码，理解业务函数、动作参数和状态；源码更新属于应用改造，不是日常操作的前置步骤
用 MiniAppBrowser 的 open 连接当前实例，优先 observe_bridge 读取业务状态、act_bridge 执行语义动作并核对结果，保留用户草稿，不改源码、不重载、不切换呈现。旧应用缺少接口时使用可用的 DOM/输入或说明限制；自动活动信息不能代替业务状态
workflowEn: Use OpenBitFunControl get for feature.miniapps, then inspect-app source to understand business functions, action parameters, and state. Source updates are app enhancements, not prerequisites for routine operation

Open the current instance with MiniAppBrowser; prefer observe_bridge for business state and act_bridge for semantic operations and result verification. Preserve drafts without editing source, reloading, or changing presentation. For legacy apps use available DOM/input controls or report the gap; activity is not business state

items.titleZh: 查看我的市场投稿审核进度、撤回发布申请与预览展示页
items.titleEn: Track your Market submissions, withdraw pending releases, and render showcase slides

control.reasonZh: 智能体已能提交完成的 Mini App；撤回、审核队列和幻灯片渲染仍依赖账户权限或当前界面状态，因此保留准确入口而不扩大工具承诺。
control.reasonEn: The Agent can submit a completed Mini App; withdrawal, review queues, and slide rendering still depend on account permissions or live UI state, so the contract keeps an exact entry without overstating tool support.

stepsZh: 从「首页 → 小应用」区域（或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「打开 Mini Apps」）进入小应用中心，浏览「已安装」或「市场」
想装现成的可在市场点安装，或点击「导入小应用」加载本地包；想从零自己做，在首页点「创建小应用」、在小应用页点「使用创造模式创建」，或直接在任意会话里告诉智能体你想做什么工具
点击应用图标即可在独立标签页启动使用（也可从「首页」小应用图标栏一键秒开）；若应用请求访问本地目录，按提示审查授权
需要二次改造时，既可直接让智能体修改指定小应用，也可开启定制草稿边改边预览，不满意随时回滚旧版本
stepsEn: Open Home → Mini Apps (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open Mini Apps) to browse Installed apps or explore the Market

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → 外部导入”
确认“外部应用”标题旁的“自动发现”开关已开启，从“已识别”列表中点选 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 或 ZCode
想要导入配置：点开对应的 Skill、MCP 或 Hook 分类弹窗，搜索勾选目标条目、处理同名冲突并确认保存副本
前往对应的“Skills”、“MCP”或“自动化”设置页确认副本已启用、凭据或服务连接已就绪
想要续聊外部会话：直接在对应工作区打开已发现的 Codex / ZCode 会话查看最新历史，发送第一条消息即自动切出独立分支续聊
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Tools & Integrations → External import
Ensure Automatic discovery is enabled beside External apps, then pick a detected source such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or ZCode
To migrate assets: open the Skill, MCP, or Hook category dialog, select items, resolve any naming conflicts, and confirm saving copies
Visit the matching Skills, MCP, or Automation settings page to enable imported copies and verify connections or credentials
To continue past chats: open a discovered Codex or ZCode session in your workspace—sending your first message automatically forks a clean branch

capabilities.summaryZh: 把项目放在远程 Linux 服务器、Docker 容器或 Windows WSL 中直接打开——你在本机流畅浏览与对话，文件读写、全文搜索、终端命令和智能体工具全部在目标环境原生执行。
capabilities.summaryEn: Open projects directly on a remote SSH server, inside a Docker container, or in Windows WSL—browse and chat smoothly on your machine while file I/O, search, terminals, and agent tools run natively in the target environment.
highlightsZh: 直连 SSH 主机、跳板机、远程 Docker 容器与本机 WSL 发行版
文件树、搜索、终端与智能体共享同一远程数据面，绝不静默误改本机
支持一键探测远程监听端口并转发到本机浏览器预览
支持拖拽或菜单上传、下载文件并随时取消大文件传输
highlightsEn: Connect directly to SSH hosts, jump hosts, remote Docker containers, and local WSL distributions
Share one remote data plane across files, search, terminals, and agents without silent local fallback
Detect remote listening ports and forward them to localhost for instant preview
Upload and download files between local and remote hosts with cancellable transfers

items.titleZh: 保存、测试与管理常用 SSH 连接配置
items.titleEn: Save, test, and manage reusable SSH connection profiles

control.reasonZh: 「保存、测试与管理常用 SSH 连接配置」涉及填写主机参数、连通性探测与删除确认；智能体会为你打开连接配置界面，由你核对并保存目标主机。
control.reasonEn: "Save, test, and manage reusable SSH connection profiles" involves editing host parameters, running live connectivity checks, and confirming removals; the Agent opens the connection setup dialog so you can review and save the host.

items.titleZh: 支持密码、私钥、证书、~/.ssh/config 与跳板机登录
items.titleEn: Authenticate via passwords, keys, certificates, ~/.ssh/config, and jump hosts

control.reasonZh: SSH 密码、私钥与证书属于秘密输入，必须由用户通过受保护的凭据入口提供；智能体不会读取或回显这些秘密。
control.reasonEn: SSH passwords, private keys, and certificates are secret inputs that must enter through the protected credential flow; the Agent neither reads nor echoes them.

items.titleZh: 自动发现远程 Docker 容器并进入容器内开发
items.titleEn: Discover remote Docker containers and work directly inside a container

control.reasonZh: 「自动发现远程 Docker 容器并进入容器内开发」需要先连接宿主机并从实时容器列表中选择目标环境；智能体可打开远程项目向导，由你选定容器与目录。
control.reasonEn: "Discover remote Docker containers and work directly inside a container" requires connecting to the host and picking from live running containers; the Agent opens the remote project wizard so you can select the container and folder.

items.titleZh: 在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区
items.titleEn: Open a Windows WSL distribution directly as a Linux workspace

control.reasonZh: 「在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区」需要读取当前 Windows 主机的发行版列表并由你选定 Linux 用户与工作目录；智能体会打开连接配置入口供你选择。
control.reasonEn: "Open a Windows WSL distribution directly as a Linux workspace" requires listing distributions on the Windows host and choosing a Linux user and directory; the Agent opens the connection dialog so you can pick them.

items.titleZh: 打开、关闭或移除远程工作区并查看远端系统信息
items.titleEn: Open, close, or remove remote workspaces and inspect host details

control.reasonZh: 「打开、关闭或移除远程工作区并查看远端系统信息」依赖当前已连接主机与你在目录浏览器中选定的路径；智能体会打开对应入口，由你确认要打开或移除的远程项目。
control.reasonEn: "Open, close, or remove remote workspaces and inspect host details" depends on the active host connection and folder selection; the Agent opens the workspace flow so you can confirm which remote project to open or remove.

items.titleZh: 在远端文件树直接浏览、搜索、编辑、重命名与删除文件
items.titleEn: Browse, search, edit, rename, and delete files directly on the remote host

workflowZh: 在已打开的远程工作区中直接使用 LS/Read/Glob/Grep；这些工具沿用会话的远程数据面
写入、编辑、删除或重命名分别使用 Write/Edit/Delete/ExecCommand，失败时明确返回远程连接或能力状态，禁止静默落到本机
workflowEn: Use LS, Read, Glob, and Grep directly in an opened remote workspace; they follow the session's remote data plane
Use Write, Edit, Delete, or ExecCommand for mutations and rename; surface remote connection or capability failures explicitly and never fall back locally

items.titleZh: 在本机与远端之间上传、下载文件或压缩包并可随时取消
items.titleEn: Upload and download files or archives between local and remote hosts

control.reasonZh: 「在本机与远端之间上传、下载文件或压缩包并可随时取消」需要你在本机与远端目录之间选择源文件及保存路径，并跟踪实时传输进度；智能体会打开文件面板交由你确认操作。
control.reasonEn: "Upload and download files or archives between local and remote hosts" requires picking local and remote paths and monitoring live transfer progress; the Agent opens the file surface so you can confirm the transfer.

items.titleZh: 在远端环境执行构建与长耗时命令并保持交互控制
items.titleEn: Run builds and long-running commands natively in the remote environment

workflowZh: 在远程工作区上下文中用 ExecCommand 启动命令，并保留长任务返回的 session_id
用 WriteStdin 输入或轮询输出，用 ExecControl 中断或终止；连接断开和不支持状态必须明确返回
workflowEn: Start commands with ExecCommand in the remote-workspace context and retain the session_id returned for long-running work
Use WriteStdin for input or polling and ExecControl to interrupt or terminate; disconnected and unsupported states must be explicit

items.titleZh: 探测远端监听端口并一键开启或关闭本地端口转发
items.titleEn: Detect remote listening ports and start or stop local port forwarding

workflowZh: 若 PortForward 是延迟工具，先加载契约；先列出或探测远程端口，再对明确目标启动转发
保留返回的转发标识，用 list 检查状态并在不再需要时 stop；不得猜测远程主机或端口
workflowEn: Load PortForward if deferred; list or detect remote ports first, then start forwarding for an explicit target
Keep the returned forwarding identifier, inspect it with list, and stop it when no longer needed; never guess the remote host or port

items.titleZh: 查看实时 SSH 连接状态，按需断开单个或全部连接
items.titleEn: Monitor live SSH connection state and disconnect one or all sessions

control.reasonZh: 「查看实时 SSH 连接状态，按需断开单个或全部连接」会改变当前已打开远程工作区的在线状态，需根据实时连接列表确认断开范围；智能体会打开连接状态入口供你操作。
control.reasonEn: "Monitor live SSH connection state and disconnect one or all sessions" affects live remote workspaces and requires choosing which active connection to close; the Agent opens the connection control entry for confirmation.

stepsZh: 点击左侧边栏「会话」旁的 + 按钮（或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 选择「新建项目」），切换连接方式为 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL
选择已保存的主机或从系统 ~/.ssh/config 导入配置，填写认证信息（支持密码、私钥、证书与跳板机）并测试连接
在远程目录选择器中选定项目文件夹打开工作区，侧边栏和终端即刻切换到目标环境
像本地项目一样编辑与对话；需要访问远端 Web 服务时，直接让智能体转发对应端口
stepsEn: Click + beside Sessions in the left sidebar (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → New project) and choose SSH, Docker container, or WSL
Pick a saved connection or import a host from ~/.ssh/config, enter credentials (password, key, certificate, or jump host), and test the connection
Browse and select the target project folder to open the remote workspace
Edit files, run terminals, and collaborate with agents natively on the remote host; ask the agent to forward ports whenever you need local browser access
agentExamplesZh: 看看远端服务器现在监听了哪些开发端口，帮我把 3000 端口转发到本机
在当前远程工作区运行测试套件，定位失败用例并直接修复
帮我连接一个新的 SSH 远程工作区
agentExamplesEn: Check which dev ports are listening on the remote host and forward port 3000 to my machine
Run the test suite in this remote workspace, find the failing case, and fix it
Open remote-project setup so I can connect an SSH workspace

capabilities.titleZh: Remote Connect 远控与多设备互控
capabilities.summaryZh: 离开工位也能用手机网页，或接入微信、飞书、Telegram 中的聊天机器人查看对话进度、审批权限并继续指挥；同账号多台电脑还能开启 Peer Device Mode，在一个窗口里直接切换操作另一台机器的工作区与会话。
capabilities.summaryEn: Follow sessions, approve permissions, and keep working from Mobile Web or a WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram bot—or enter Peer Device Mode to browse and drive another same-account computer right from your current OpenBitFun window.
highlightsZh: 手机扫码即连：官方 Relay 免部署开箱即用，桌面端还可同时开启局域网 Relay
接入微信、飞书或 Telegram 机器人，在常用聊天软件里收发进度与批复权限
同账号多设备互控（Peer Mode）：左侧边栏直接展开另一台电脑的项目与会话
智能体可直接帮你启停远控渠道、生成微信扫码登录并查看监听状态
highlightsEn: Scan to connect from phone: zero-setup official Relay plus optional concurrent Desktop LAN Relay
Pair a WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram bot to chat and approve permissions from your messenger
Same-account Peer Device Mode: expand and operate another computer’s workspaces right in your sidebar
Ask the agent directly to start/stop channels, launch WeChat QR login, or inspect listener health

items.titleZh: 本机可被控制
items.titleEn: Allow control of this device

control.reasonZh: 请在当前设备的「设备与连接」概览中切换「本机可被控制」，选择其他设备能否连接这台设备。
control.reasonEn: Choose “Allow control of this device” in the local Devices & Connections overview to set whether other devices can connect to this one.

items.titleZh: 使用免部署官方 Relay 或桌面端局域网 Relay（可同时开启）
items.titleEn: Use the zero-setup official Relay or Desktop LAN Relay concurrently

control.reasonZh: 「使用免部署官方 Relay 或桌面端局域网 Relay（可同时开启）」需要结合你当前的网络环境确认连接入口；官方 Relay 开箱即用，私有 Relay 仅面向配套定制客户端构建，界面不提供自定义服务器地址输入。
control.reasonEn: "Use the zero-setup official Relay or Desktop LAN Relay concurrently" depends on your current network setup and host confirmation; the official Relay needs no deployment, while private Relays require matching custom builds rather than a custom URL field.

items.titleZh: 一键启动、停用远控渠道并查看实时连接与设备信息
items.titleEn: Start or stop Remote Connect channels and inspect live connection status

items.titleZh: 查看本机局域网地址、网络网卡状态与扫码邀请链接
items.titleEn: Inspect LAN IP addresses, network interfaces, and shareable QR invitations

control.reasonZh: 「查看本机局域网地址、网络网卡状态与扫码邀请链接」涉及查看本机实时网卡地址与屏幕上展示邀请二维码供手机扫描；智能体会为你直接打开「设备与连接」中的「手机或浏览器」连接面板。
control.reasonEn: "Inspect LAN IP addresses, network interfaces, and shareable QR invitations" involves inspecting live network interfaces and displaying a visual QR invitation for your phone; the Agent opens the Phone or browser panel in Devices & Connections directly for you.

items.titleZh: 接入微信扫码、飞书或 Telegram 聊天机器人（每次连接一个聊天应用，与手机远控并行不悖）
items.titleEn: Connect a WeChat (QR login), Feishu, or Telegram bot alongside Mobile Web

items.titleZh: 通过 GitHub 或邮箱验证码登录账号并查看身份状态
items.titleEn: Sign in with GitHub or an email verification code and check account status

control.reasonZh: 登录必须由用户在外部认证页面完成。GitHub 与邮箱是独立账号，各设备需使用同一种方式和同一账号；旧客户端或服务可能仅支持 GitHub。智能体可打开入口并读取非秘密状态，不能代替用户认证。
control.reasonEn: The user must complete sign-in on the external authentication page. GitHub and email are independent accounts; devices need the same method and account. Older clients or services may support GitHub only. The Agent may open the entry and read non-secret status, but cannot authenticate for the user.

items.titleZh: 查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备
items.titleEn: Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal

control.reasonZh: 「查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备」需要核对控制端账户下的具体设备并确认别名修改或移除操作（若只想让智能体列出可用设备，可直接调用远程派发的列出目标能力）。
control.reasonEn: "Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal" requires selecting a specific device under the controller account and confirming alias edits or removal (to simply read the device list in chat, use list-targets on Detached Dispatch).

items.titleZh: 开启 Peer Device Mode，在当前窗口无缝接管另一台电脑的工作区
items.titleEn: Use Peer Device Mode to operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window

control.reasonZh: 「开启 Peer Device Mode，在当前窗口无缝接管另一台电脑的工作区」会切换当前窗口所绑定的远端主机数据面，需要你在侧边栏或设备面板明确点击目标设备确认切换。
control.reasonEn: "Use Peer Device Mode to operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window" switches the active window’s live data plane to another host and requires an explicit device selection in the sidebar or device switcher.

stepsZh: 点击左下角设备状态按钮打开「管理设备」（即「设备与连接」弹窗），先在「概览」或「我的设备」中登录账号；登录后左侧会显示「手机或浏览器」与「聊天应用」
手机或跨电脑互控：在两台设备使用同一种方式（同为 GitHub 或同为邮箱验证码）登录同一账号；官方 Relay 无需额外部署
手机远控可在「手机或浏览器」中扫描官方或桌面局域网邀请二维码并确认目标设备；跨电脑互控直接在左侧边栏展开对应设备即可进入 Peer Mode
机器人远控：在「聊天应用」选择微信扫码（或加载飞书 / Telegram 凭据配置），把返回的配对码发给机器人完成绑定
stepsEn: Click the bottom-left device status control → Manage devices to open Devices & Connections, and sign in under Overview or My devices; once signed in, Phone or browser and Chat apps appear in the dialog sidebar
For mobile or cross-computer control, sign in on every device using the exact same login method (GitHub or email code) and account; the official Relay works out of the box
On mobile, scan the official or LAN invitation QR under Phone or browser and confirm the host; on another computer, simply expand that device in the left sidebar to enter Peer Device Mode
For IM bots, open Chat apps to scan the WeChat QR (or supply your Feishu / Telegram bot config) and send the pairing code to the bot chat to finish linking
agentExamplesZh: 开启手机网页远控，我想在手机上接着看进度
帮我启动微信机器人登录二维码，配好消息监听
查看当前远控和机器人的运行状态
暂时停用 Telegram 机器人，保留已有配置
agentExamplesEn: Enable Mobile Web remote control so I can follow this session from my phone
Start WeChat bot QR login and set up message listening
Check the current Remote Connect and bot status
Stop the Telegram bot for now while keeping its configuration

operations.descriptionZh: 读取当前执行主机的监听、配对、停用与恢复错误；不返回凭据，监听任务存活不等于消息已完成往返。
operations.descriptionEn: Read listener, pairing, disabled and restore-error state on the executing host without credentials. A live listener task does not prove a message round trip.

operations.descriptionZh: 启动指定机器人或手机网页远控。CLI 自动启动 daemon，退出当前聊天后继续监听。新机器人需将返回的配对码发给机器人；CLI 不支持局域网 Relay。
operations.descriptionEn: Start the selected bot or Mobile Web. CLI starts its daemon and keeps listening after this chat exits. Send the returned pairing code to a new bot. CLI does not host a LAN Relay.

operations.descriptionZh: 停用选定渠道并保留配置和会话。机器人停用状态跨重启保留。关闭手机网页会同时断开该主机的 Peer 设备路由，机器人保持运行。
operations.descriptionEn: Stop the selected channel while retaining configuration and sessions. Bot disablement survives restart. Stopping Mobile Web also disconnects Peer routing on this host; bots keep running.

operations.titleZh: 从主机凭据文件配置机器人
operations.titleEn: Configure a bot from a private host credential file
operations.descriptionZh: 读取执行主机上用户提供的私有 JSON 凭据文件并保存配置；不会自动启动。文件包含 bot_type 和对应凭据字段，需绝对路径和仅所有者可读权限；不要把凭据贴到聊天中。远程工作区路径不能用作主机凭据路径。
operations.descriptionEn: Load a user-supplied private JSON BotConfig file on the executing host, with bot_type and provider credential fields; save without starting. Requires an absolute host path and owner-only permissions. Do not paste credentials into chat or use a remote-workspace path.

operations.descriptionZh: 生成微信登录二维码。CLI TUI 在工具卡片中直接显示 qrTerminal，无需模型重写；其他终端逐字显示，图形界面显示 qrImageUrl，再用 sessionKey 轮询。扫码本身尚未完成机器人监听和配对。
operations.descriptionEn: Create a WeChat login QR. CLI TUI renders qrTerminal in the tool card without model transcription; other terminals show it verbatim and graphical surfaces show qrImageUrl. Poll using sessionKey; scanning alone does not complete listening and pairing.

operations.titleZh: 完成微信登录并启动监听
operations.titleEn: Complete WeChat login and start listening
operations.descriptionZh: 轮询同一登录会话。确认后在主机保存凭据并启动监听，向用户展示返回的机器人配对码。凭据不会返回给模型。
operations.descriptionEn: Poll the same login session. Confirmation saves credentials on the host and starts listening; show the returned bot pairing code. Credentials are never returned to the model.

operations.descriptionZh: 切换所有机器人的详细输出模式并保存。
operations.descriptionEn: Persist verbose output mode for all bot channels.

capabilities.summaryZh: 把耗时的编码、测试或重构任务从当前 Git 工作区派发到另一台同账号设备或 SSH 主机执行。提交后你可以直接合上电脑离开——目标机器在独立 Worktree 中持续跑完并保存完整事件流，重连后随时回看进度、远程批复权限或把代码同步回来。
capabilities.summaryEn: Send long-running coding, test, or refactoring jobs from your current Git workspace to another same-account device or SSH host. Close your laptop right after submitting—the target runs in an isolated Git worktree, records every event, and lets you answer permissions or sync changes back whenever you reconnect.
highlightsZh: 可选择已配置的 SSH 主机派发任务，智能体也可派发到同账号设备
提交后控制端可随时断网或休眠，目标机在独立 Git Worktree 自治执行
断线重连后按游标增量回填完整对话与工具轨迹，支持远程回答权限请求
任务完成后可将目标端改动安全同步回本机，绝不把本机当成脆弱的文件代理
highlightsEn: Dispatch to a configured SSH host, or ask the Agent to dispatch to a same-account device
Disconnect or close your laptop freely while the target works in an isolated Git worktree
Replay missed events incrementally by cursor on reconnect and answer pending permissions remotely
Sync completed changes back cleanly without turning your controller into a fragile file proxy

items.titleEn: List same-account devices and saved SSH dispatch targets

items.titleZh: 在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机
items.titleEn: Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission

control.reasonZh: 「在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机」需要核对目标端缺失的模型配置并由你确认跨机同步；智能体会打开派发准备入口保留可见确认。
control.reasonEn: "Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission" requires reviewing missing model settings on the target and confirming cross-host sync; the Agent opens the dispatch preparation UI for your review.

items.titleZh: 从当前 Git 工作区向设备或 SSH 目标提交可离线运行的持久任务
items.titleEn: Submit a durable Git-worktree job to a same-account device or SSH target

items.titleZh: 查看本机或目标机持有的派发任务列表、实时进度与错误详情
items.titleEn: List dispatched jobs and inspect live status, incremental events, and errors

items.titleZh: 断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录
items.titleEn: Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts

control.reasonZh: 「断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录」由会话界面随重连游标自动回填与持久化同步；智能体会直接为你打开对应的派发会话视图查看完整上下文。
control.reasonEn: "Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts" is synchronized automatically with resumable cursors in the session view; the Agent opens the dispatched session so you can inspect the full transcript.

items.titleZh: 远程批复目标端等待中的权限请求并继续推进任务
items.titleEn: Answer pending target-side permission requests remotely and continue work

control.reasonZh: 「远程批复目标端等待中的权限请求并继续推进任务」需要你逐条审阅待授权的操作内容与后续补充指令；智能体会定位到该会话的审批界面交由你拍板。
control.reasonEn: "Answer pending target-side permission requests remotely and continue work" requires your explicit review of each guarded operation and any follow-up instructions; the Agent opens the session approval prompt for your decision.

items.titleZh: 随时远程取消本机派发的正在运行任务
items.titleEn: Cancel an active dispatch job submitted from this host

control.reasonZh: 「将目标机完成的代码改动安全同步回本机工作区」涉及对比本机当前分支状态与确认合并方式；智能体会打开派发结果同步入口，确保不会意外覆盖你未保存的本地改动。
control.reasonEn: "Sync completed target-side code changes back to your local workspace" involves checking local working-tree state and confirming how changes land; the Agent opens the result-sync flow so local edits are never overwritten.

stepsZh: 先在 SSH 目标上安装兼容的 OpenBitFun CLI，并保存 SSH 连接。
在聊天输入框底部点击「本机」，选择 SSH 主机。要派发到同账号设备时，直接告诉智能体目标设备和任务。
发送任务后，目标主机会同步所需的模型配置，并在独立的 Git worktree 中执行任务。
执行期间可随时离线；重新打开会话即可查看最新进度、批复等待中的权限，完成后一键将结果同步回本机工作区
stepsEn: Install a compatible OpenBitFun CLI on the SSH target and save its SSH connection.
Select an SSH host from the This computer menu in the composer. To use a same-account device, ask the Agent to dispatch your task to that device.
Submit the task. The target syncs the required model configuration and runs the job in a dedicated Git worktree.
Disconnect anytime; reopen the session later to catch up on streamed events, approve pending permissions, or sync finished changes back locally

operations.descriptionZh: 读取同账户下所有 OpenBitFun 设备（含本机，带 isCurrentDevice 标记、在线状态、型号与系统）以及本机已保存的 SSH 连接。回答“有几台设备”或派发前先调用；未登录账户时 devices 为空并说明原因。
operations.descriptionEn: Read every OpenBitFun device on this account (including this one, marked isCurrentDevice, with online state, model and OS) plus this host's saved SSH connections. Call it before stating how many devices exist or before submitting; when signed out, devices is empty with a reason.

operations.descriptionZh: 把任务提交到另一台同账户设备（名称、别名或 device:<id>）或 SSH 目标（ssh:<connectionId>）。目标在自己的 Git worktree 中从 baseRef（默认 HEAD）开始执行，本机可以断开。仅在用户明确要求派发时调用，并明确选择 approvalPolicy；离线设备直接报错，不会在本机执行。
operations.descriptionEn: Submit work to another same-account device (name, alias, or device:<id>) or SSH target (ssh:<connectionId>). The target runs in its own Git worktree branched from baseRef (default HEAD) and this host may disconnect. Call only when the user asked to dispatch, and choose approvalPolicy explicitly; an offline device is an error, never a local run.

operations.descriptionZh: 按 jobId 读取本机派发任务的状态与增量事件；cursor 传上次返回值以只取新事件。
operations.descriptionEn: Read state and incremental events of a job submitted from this host; pass the previous cursor to read only new events.

operations.descriptionZh: 不带 target 时列出本机提交过的任务；带 target 时直接询问该目标正在持有的任务。
operations.descriptionEn: Without target, list jobs submitted from this host; with target, ask that target for the jobs it owns.

operations.descriptionZh: 取消本机提交的指定任务；目标端停止执行并保留记录。
operations.descriptionEn: Cancel a job submitted from this host; the target stops it and keeps its record.

capabilities.summaryZh: 不用买服务器、不用配繁琐的部署流水线——把智能体生成的交互网页、产品原型、数据报告或个人作品集直接发布成在线链接，自由控制公开或私密访问权限，每次更新自动保存历史版本，随时一键回滚或下线。
capabilities.summaryEn: Skip server setup and CI pipelines—publish AI-built webpages, interactive prototypes, reports, or portfolios to a live URL in seconds. Control public or private visibility, keep immutable version history on every save, and roll back or unpublish anytime.
highlightsZh: 一句话把本地或刚生成的 HTML 网页打包保存并发布到专属在线地址
三级访问权限随心切：仅自己可见（private）、登录用户可见（relay）或完全公开（public）
每次修改都会生成不可变历史版本，可先保存预览、确认后再切流量上线，随时一键回退旧版
支持随时取消发布（保留历史版本备查）或彻底删除单个版本与整个页面
highlightsEn: Turn any generated or workspace webpage bundle into a hosted URL right from chat or the Pages manager
Switch visibility anytime between Private (only you), Relay (signed-in users), and Public (anyone with the link)
Every save records an immutable version—stage updates safely before deploying live, and roll back in one click
Unpublish a Page to take it offline without losing history, or delete specific versions when cleaning up

items.titleZh: 列出账号下全部已发布与未发布的 Pages 及其状态、权限和链接
items.titleEn: List all published and unpublished Pages with their URLs, visibility, and timestamps

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=list 列出已发布页面的名称、URL、权限和更新时间；published_only=false 包含未发布页面
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=list for published Page names, URLs, visibility and update times; published_only=false includes unpublished Pages

items.titleZh: 每次保存自动生成不可变历史版本，随时翻阅完整版本记录
items.titleEn: Save immutable Page versions automatically and browse full version history

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=publish/update 保存完整内容为新版本，action=versions 查看版本历史
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=publish/update to save complete content as a new version, and action=versions for history

items.titleZh: 保存、发布网页或将任意历史版本一键重新部署上线
items.titleEn: Publish or deploy a selected Page version live

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=publish/update 保存内容；仅用户要求上线时设置 deploy=true；action=deploy 切换到已有版本
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=publish/update to save content, set deploy=true only when requested, and action=deploy to promote an existing version

items.titleZh: 灵活修改页面标题，并在私密、登录可见与公开之间随时切换
items.titleEn: Update Page titles and switch between private, signed-in, and public visibility

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=update 修改标题，action=permissions 将访问权限设置为 private、relay 或 public
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=update for the title and action=permissions to set private, relay or public visibility

items.titleZh: 一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接
items.titleEn: Create and open a shareable access link for any Page

control.reasonZh: 「一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接」涉及在当前客户端生成带会话上下文的打开链接或复制到剪贴板；智能体会为你打开 Pages 管理页（公开链接也可直接通过列表读取）。
control.reasonEn: "Create and open a shareable access link for any Page" generates an openable session link or copies it in the UI; the Agent opens the Pages scene so you can launch or share it directly.

items.titleZh: 随时一键下线已发布的页面，同时完好保留所有历史版本
items.titleEn: Unpublish a live Page offline while keeping all saved versions intact

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=unpublish 下线页面并保留已保存版本
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=unpublish to take a Page offline while retaining saved versions

items.titleZh: 按需清理单个冗余历史版本，或彻底删除整个 Page
items.titleEn: Delete an individual old version or remove an entire Page permanently

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=delete 删除整个页面；提供 version_id 时仅删除该版本
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=delete to delete a Page, or supply version_id to delete only that version

stepsZh: 先点击左下角设备状态按钮 →「管理设备」（设备与连接），在「概览」或「我的设备」中登录 OpenBitFun 账号（支持 GitHub 或邮箱验证码；CLI 用户可执行 `/login`）
在对话中直接告诉智能体要发布或更新的页面内容与可见性（例如“把这个网页发布成公开 Page”），或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索 `Pages` 打开可视化管理页
在 Pages 管理页（或智能体返回结果中）获取可分享链接、浏览历史版本列表、修改页面标题与访问权限，或随时切换线上版本与下线
stepsEn: Click the bottom-left Device Menu → Manage devices (Devices & Connections) and sign in under Overview or My devices with GitHub or an email code (or `/login` in the CLI)
Ask the agent in chat to publish or update your page (e.g., "Publish this HTML prototype as a public Page"), or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and search "Pages" to open the visual manager
Copy shareable links, browse version history, change titles or public/private access, promote an earlier version, or unpublish anytime

capabilities.summaryZh: 提供两套互补的语音体验：平时在聊天框点一下麦克风，用本机离线模型（轻量默认的 SenseVoice 支持自动识别中英粤日韩，或下载 Qwen3-ASR 解锁 30+ 语言，录音不上传）快速把口述转成可编辑文字；想彻底解放双手时，在非会话视图点右下角 Hi 打开悬浮对话窗（或开启悬浮窗模式）并点顶部电话图标「切换到实时语音」，像打电话一样让助手跨项目跑任务并播报进展。
capabilities.summaryEn: Two complementary ways to work by voice: click the composer mic for fast, private on-device dictation (lightweight SenseVoice for Auto/ZH/Yue/EN/JA/KO, or Qwen3-ASR for 30+ languages—audio never leaves your machine), or open the floating conversation dock from the bottom-right Hi launcher on non-session views (or Floating Window mode) and click the header phone icon (Switch to realtime voice) to run project tasks hands-free.
highlightsZh: 本地离线听写：提供轻量 SenseVoice（中英粤日韩）与多语种 Qwen3-ASR（30+ 语言）两款本地模型，录音不出本机
转写文字自动填入输入框草稿，发送前可从容补充代码路径或修正术语
设置页内置麦克风选择与一键试录测速，直观查看推理耗时与识别效果
客户端级实时语音通话（右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式 → 顶部电话图标）：口述即可让助手进入项目启动/停止任务并语音播报进展
highlightsEn: Private on-device dictation: choose lightweight SenseVoice (ZH/Yue/EN/JA/KO) or Qwen3-ASR (30+ languages) so audio never uploads
Transcribed text lands right in your chat draft so you can review or tweak terms before hitting send
Built-in microphone picker and live recognition test in Settings showing exact inference timing
Client-wide realtime voice calls (bottom-right Hi dock or Floating Window mode → header phone icon): talk naturally to launch or stop project tasks and hear spoken updates

items.titleZh: 在聊天输入框一键开始、完成或取消语音听写录音
items.titleEn: Start, finish, or cancel voice dictation right from the chat composer

control.reasonZh: 「在聊天输入框一键开始、完成或取消语音听写录音」需要你亲自对着麦克风说话并控制录音起止；智能体会为你打开语音设置或引导使用输入框麦克风按钮。
control.reasonEn: "Start, finish, or cancel voice dictation right from the chat composer" requires live microphone speaking and user-timed start/stop control; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can enable and use the composer mic.

items.titleZh: 录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态
items.titleEn: Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status

control.reasonZh: 「录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态」随聊天输入框的实时录音会话自动工作；智能体会打开语音配置入口方便你检查麦克风与模型就绪状态。
control.reasonEn: "Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status" runs automatically during an active composer recording; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can verify model and mic readiness.

items.titleZh: 从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务

control.reasonZh: 「从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务」依赖实时麦克风收音、双向音频流与你的口头指令；智能体会打开对应入口并将通话控制与任务进展保留在可见界面。
control.reasonEn: "Switch to a client-wide realtime voice call from the Hi dock or Floating Window mode to run or stop project tasks" depends on live microphone input, streaming audio playback, and spoken commands; the Agent opens the voice setup and keeps call controls visible.

control.reasonEn: "Browse, download, verify, repair, or delete local SenseVoice and Qwen3-ASR speech models" involves disk space, live download progress, and deletion confirmation; the Agent opens Input & Interaction → Voice settings for you.

control.reasonEn: "Choose Auto or an explicit recognition language and pick your active system microphone" depends on your connected audio hardware and language preference; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can pick the right mic and language.

control.reasonZh: 「在设置页直接试录一段话，测试麦克风收音并查看毫秒级推理耗时」需要你现场开口试录并核对识别文本；智能体会直接定位到语音测试面板交由你体验。
control.reasonEn: "Run a quick mic and recognition test in Settings with millisecond timing feedback" requires speaking a live test phrase and checking the transcribed output; the Agent opens the Voice diagnostics section for you.

items.titleEn: Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending

control.reasonZh: 「识别完成后将文字放回聊天输入框，方便补充修改后再发送」在当前聊天输入框草稿中直接完成；录音结束后你可自由增删文字或附加文件，满意后再按发送。
control.reasonEn: "Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending" takes place directly inside your live chat composer draft so you can refine wording or attach files before sending.

stepsZh: 配置本地语音听写：打开「设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 输入与交互 → 语音」，按语种需求下载 SenseVoice 或 Qwen3-ASR 本地模型并开启输入框语音按钮，随后在聊天框点麦克风即可口述转文字
配置实时语音通话：打开「设置 → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手 → 实时语音通话」，开启客户端语音助手并填写火山引擎实时语音 API Key 与音色 ID（默认 Jupiter，修改后自动生效）
发起实时通话：在首页、设置等非会话页面点击右下角的 `Hi` 按钮打开悬浮对话窗（或从左下角齿轮菜单进入「悬浮窗模式」），再点击窗口顶部电话图标「切换到实时语音」即可开口指挥，随时可静音或切回文字聊天
stepsEn: Set up local dictation: go to Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Input & Interaction → Voice, download SenseVoice or Qwen3-ASR, enable the composer mic button, and click the mic in chat to dictate

Set up realtime voice calls: go to Settings → Application & Interface → Pet & assistant → Real-time voice calls, enable the client voice assistant, and enter your Volcengine Realtime API Key and voice ID (defaults to Jupiter; changes save automatically)

Start talking: on non-session views like Home or Settings, click the bottom-right `Hi` button to open the floating dock (or enter Floating window mode from the bottom-left menu), then click the header phone icon (Switch to realtime voice) to talk, trigger or stop tasks, mute, or switch back to text chat

capabilities.summaryZh: 让智能体把倒计时提醒、上线核对清单、PR 状态、接口健康指标或行情看板做成轻巧的独立小卡片，贴在屏幕任意顺眼的位置——支持定时自动拉取数据刷新、Windows 桌面图标层固定，关掉应用再重开也会按原位置和尺寸自动恢复。
capabilities.summaryEn: Let agents place lightweight, draggable cards outside the main window for glanceable info like countdowns, checklists, PR status, service metrics, or quotes—with automatic HTTP/command refresh, Windows desktop-layer pinning, and exact position/size restore on relaunch.
highlightsZh: 一句话创建倒计时、待办清单、便签、进度条、指标卡、图表卡等多种形态，支持定时自动刷新
卡片上可直接打勾清单、手动刷新、置顶悬浮，或一键跳回创建它的原始会话
Windows 支持「固定到桌面」嵌入桌面图标之上、应用窗口之下，像原生桌面小组件一样不挡视线
在「首页 → 小卡片」或设置页统一查看、显示、隐藏或删除所有卡片，重启应用自动恢复布局
highlightsEn: Ask in chat for countdown, checklist, note, progress, metric, chart, or custom cards—with optional scheduled HTTP or local-command refresh
Check off tasks, refresh live data, toggle always-on-top, open links, or jump straight back to the source session from any card
On Windows, pin cards to the desktop layer (above desktop icons, behind app windows) so they never block active work
Manage visibility and clean up cards in one place from Home → Desktop cards or Settings, with layout restored across restarts

items.titleZh: 一句话创建倒计时、清单、便签、进度、指标与图表卡片，支持 HTTP 或命令定时刷新
items.titleEn: Create countdown, checklist, note, progress, metric, and chart cards with optional live refresh

workflowZh: 不确定卡片形态时先用 `presets` 查看预置卡片，再用 `create` 创建；需要定时刷新时为卡片提供 http 或 command 数据源
用 `list`/`get` 读取已有卡片，避免重复创建；用 `update`、`show`、`hide`、`delete`、`refresh` 维护卡片
小卡片仅在桌面端可用，远程控制会话无法使用；远程工作区不能使用本机命令数据源，失败时明确告知用户
workflowEn: When unsure about the card shape, call `presets` first, then `create`; give the card an http or command data source when it should refresh

items.titleZh: 控制登录桌面系统后是否自动启动 OpenBitFun

options.descriptionZh: 应用启动后自动检查新版本提醒，安装与重启仍需你确认（默认开启）。

options.descriptionZh: 当窗口不在前台且智能体完成当前回合时发送系统通知（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Send a desktop notification when a session turn finishes while the window is unfocused (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 当智能体暂停等待你批准工具或命令权限时发送系统通知（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Send a desktop notification when an agent is waiting for your permission approval (on by default).

capabilities.summaryZh: 配置本地离线语音输入（SenseVoice / Qwen3-ASR 双模型）、执行中的消息发送策略（立即纠偏 vs 排队）、侧问关闭保护与划词操作栏。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure on-device speech-to-text dictation (SenseVoice & Qwen3-ASR local models), mid-turn message sending (immediate steering vs queueing), /btw close confirmation, and text-selection actions.
highlightsZh: 纯本地离线语音输入：可选轻量 SenseVoice Small（中/粤/英/日/韩）或高精度 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B（解锁 30+ 语种）
执行中消息发送策略：默认“立即发送”中途纠偏，或改“排队发送”等回合结束
侧问（/btw）关闭前确认提醒，防止随手关掉临时问答记录
对话文本划词自动弹出“添加批注 / 侧边提问”工具栏（页面底部同屏集成“快捷键”分区）
highlightsEn: 100% local offline speech-to-text with lightweight SenseVoice Small (`auto`/zh/yue/en/ja/ko) and higher-accuracy Qwen3-ASR 0.6B (unlocking 30+ languages)
Mid-turn message policy: Send Immediately (default live steering) vs Queue Until Turn Finishes
Confirmation prompt before closing a `/btw` side question whose messages are not saved
Automatic floating action bar (Annotate & Ask in Side Panel) on text selection, plus the Keyboard Shortcuts section at the bottom of the same page

items.titleZh: 配置智能体执行期间发送消息的默认行为（立即发送纠偏 vs 排队等待）

capabilities.summaryZh: 按外观、行为、显示、高级四大分区精细调校代码字体、缩进换行、Minimap 缩略图与自动格式化，并支持通过智能体调整底层自动保存策略。
capabilities.summaryEn: Tune code typography, indentation, word wrap, minimap, and auto-formatting across Appearance, Behavior, Display, and Advanced sections, plus underlying autosave policy via Agent.
highlightsZh: 外观：代码字体下拉（系统默认 / Fira Code / Noto Sans SC / Consolas / Courier New，自定义字体可让智能体设置）、10–32 px 字号、行高与光标动画
行为：Tab 宽度、空格与缩进自动识别、长行自动换行、绝对/相对行号与平滑滚动
显示：Minimap 左右停靠与缩放、空白字符标记、当前行高亮与底部滚动留白
高级：语义高亮、彩色嵌套括号、保存/粘贴自动格式化，以及底层延迟自动保存配置
highlightsEn: Appearance: code font dropdown (Default, Fira Code, Noto Sans SC, Consolas, Courier New — or any custom font stack via Agent), 10–32 px size, line height, and cursor animation
Behavior: tab width, space & auto-detected indentation, word wrap, relative/normal line numbers, smooth scrolling
Display: minimap side & sizing, whitespace rendering, active-line highlight, and scroll-beyond-last-line
Advanced: semantic highlighting, bracket-pair colors, format on save/paste, plus underlying autosave policy via Agent

items.titleZh: 调整编辑行为：Tab 宽度、空格缩进、自动检测缩进、自动换行、行号与平滑滚动

items.titleZh: 调整编辑器显示：Minimap 缩略图、空白字符渲染、当前行高亮与底部滚动边界

items.titleZh: 调整高级编辑能力：语义高亮、括号配色、保存/粘贴格式化、空白清理与底层自动保存

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“编程与开发 → 编辑器”
依次在“外观、行为、显示、高级”四个分区调整字体、缩进、Minimap 与格式化开关
所有控件修改后会自动保存，并即时同步到已打开的代码编辑器标签页

Adjust font, indentation, minimap, and formatting controls across Appearance, Behavior, Display, and Advanced
Every change saves automatically and updates open code editor tabs immediately

options.descriptionZh: 界面下拉提供系统默认、Fira Code、Noto Sans SC、Consolas、Courier New；也可通过智能体或配置写入任意本机字体族与回退链。
options.descriptionEn: UI dropdown offers Default, Fira Code, Noto Sans SC, Consolas, and Courier New; custom font stacks and fallbacks can also be set via the Agent or config.

options.descriptionZh: 在普通（normal，默认）与粗体（bold）字重之间切换。
options.descriptionEn: Choose between `normal` (default) and `bold` code font weight.

options.descriptionZh: 设置代码文字像素大小（范围 10–32 px，默认 14 px）。
options.descriptionEn: Set code font size in pixels (10–32 px, default 14 px).

options.descriptionZh: 设置代码行高倍数（范围 1.0–3.0，默认 1.5）。
options.descriptionEn: Set the code line-height multiplier (1.0–3.0, default 1.5).

options.descriptionZh: 选择竖线（line，默认）、实心块（block）、下划线（underline）及对应细线样式。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `line` (default), `block`, `underline`, `line-thin`, `block-outline`, or `underline-thin`.

options.descriptionZh: 选择平滑渐变（smooth，默认）、普通闪烁（blink）、柔和（phase）、展开（expand）或常亮（solid）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `smooth` (default), `blink`, `phase`, `expand`, or `solid` cursor animation.

options.descriptionZh: 设置一个制表位对应的空格宽度（1–8，默认 4）。
options.descriptionEn: Set the number of spaces per indentation level (1–8, default 4).

options.descriptionZh: 按下 Tab 键时插入空格而非制表符（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Insert spaces instead of a literal tab character when pressing Tab (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 打开已有文件时自动沿用文件现有缩进风格，仅在无法判断时回退默认设置（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically adopt an existing file’s indentation on open, falling back to your defaults for new files (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 选择不换行（off，默认）、按视口换行（on）、按固定列宽换行（wordWrapColumn）或取较小值（bounded）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `off` (default), viewport wrap (`on`), `wordWrapColumn`, or `bounded`.

options.descriptionZh: 选择常规行号（on，默认）、隐藏（off）、相对行号（relative）或每 10 行间隔显示（interval）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `on` (default), `off`, `relative`, or 10-line `interval` numbering.

options.descriptionZh: 为代码滚动启用平滑过渡动画（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Animate vertical scrolling smoothly inside code buffers (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 显示或隐藏代码侧边全景缩略图（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Show or hide the code overview minimap (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 将代码缩略图停靠在编辑器右侧（right，默认）或左侧（left）。
options.descriptionEn: Dock the minimap on the `right` (default) or `left` edge of the editor.

options.descriptionZh: 选择按比例缩放（proportional，默认）、填满高度（fill）或自适应高度（fit）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `proportional` (default), `fill`, or `fit` minimap scaling.

options.descriptionZh: 选择仅选区显示（selection，默认）、不显示（none）、行尾/词间边界（boundary）、行尾（trailing）或全部（all）。
options.descriptionEn: Render spaces and tabs for `selection` only (default), `none`, `boundary`, `trailing`, or `all`.

options.descriptionZh: 选择仅高亮代码行（line，默认）、仅行号栏（gutter）、整行（all）或关闭（none）。
options.descriptionEn: Highlight `line` (default), `gutter`, `all`, or `none` for the active cursor line.

options.descriptionZh: 允许将文件末尾继续向上滚动到视口中部（默认关闭，位于“行为”分区）。
options.descriptionEn: Allow scrolling past the final line of a file (off by default, shown under Behavior in the UI).

options.titleZh: 自动保存策略（底层配置）
options.descriptionZh: 控制文件自动保存方式：默认延迟保存（afterDelay），也可通过智能体设为关闭（off）、编辑器失焦（onFocusChange）或窗口失焦（onWindowChange）；不在编辑器设置页单独显示开关。
options.descriptionEn: Controls file autosave (`afterDelay` by default, or `off`, `onFocusChange`, `onWindowChange`); adjustable via the Agent or config rather than shown as a UI toggle on this page.

options.titleZh: 自动保存延迟（底层配置）
options.descriptionZh: 当自动保存设为 `afterDelay` 时的等待毫秒数（默认 1000 ms，可通过智能体或配置修改）。
options.descriptionEn: Delay in milliseconds when autosave is `afterDelay` (`1000` ms default; adjustable via the Agent or config).

options.descriptionZh: 启用基于语言语义的符号着色（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Enable language-aware semantic token coloring (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 用不同颜色区分多层嵌套括号，方便快速定位闭合位置（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Colorize nested bracket pairs to make matching scopes easy to scan (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 保存文件时自动运行可用的代码格式化器（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically run available code formatters whenever a file is saved (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 粘贴代码片段时自动整理缩进与格式（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically tidy indentation and formatting when pasting code snippets (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 自动移除换行缩进时残留的多余尾随空格（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically strip trailing whitespace inserted by auto-indentation (on by default).

capabilities.summaryZh: 一站式管理 AI 供应商与订阅账号，分配主模型、快速模型与经济模型等默认槽位，并配置智能路由、模型池、独立生图、网络代理与流式超时。
capabilities.summaryEn: Manage AI providers and subscription accounts in one place, assign Primary, Fast, and Economy default slots, and configure Smart Mode routing, model pools, standalone image generation, proxies, and streaming timeouts.
highlightsZh: 接入内置厂商、自定义兼容端点、多号订阅池与 Magpie 网关一键发现
为主模型、快速模型、经济模型及视觉、生图、语音分配默认槽位
按需配置智能模式路由（主模型 + 经济模型 + 路由分类模型）或多成员模型池
支持 OpenAI Images 与阿里云百炼（DashScope Native）两种独立图像生成服务
切换请求格式时实时预览派生 URL，并在“更多设置”中分别保存代理、首次响应超时与响应间隔超时（默认均 600 秒）
highlightsEn: Connect built-in providers, custom compatible endpoints, multi-account subscription pools, and Magpie gateways
Assign Primary, Fast, and Economy defaults plus vision, image-generation, and speech slots
Configure Smart Mode routing (Primary + Economy + router classifier) or multi-member model pools
Set up standalone image generation with OpenAI Images or DashScope Native dialects
Preview derived request URLs live per API format and save proxy, First response timeout, and Response idle timeout (600s default) under More settings

items.titleZh: 添加内置或自定义供应商、探测 Magpie 网关与配置独立生图服务
items.titleEn: Add built-in or custom providers, probe Magpie gateways, and set up standalone image services

control.reasonZh: “添加内置或自定义供应商、探测 Magpie 网关与配置独立生图服务”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Add built-in or custom providers, probe Magpie gateways, and set up standalone image services” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 配置 API Key、Base URL、请求格式（含实时派生 URL 预览）与备用通道
items.titleEn: Configure API keys, base URLs, API formats with live derived URL preview, and fallback channels

control.reasonZh: API Key 必须通过受保护的模型凭据表单录入；智能体可以打开对应设置，但不会把秘密值纳入能力目录或工具结果。
control.reasonEn: API keys must be entered through the protected model-credential form; the Agent can open that setting but never places secret values in the capability graph or tool results.

items.titleZh: 登录 Codex、ZCode、OpenCode、Grok、Antigravity、Hermes 等订阅账号与多号订阅池
items.titleEn: Sign in to Codex, ZCode, OpenCode, Grok, Antigravity, Hermes, and multi-account subscription pools

control.reasonZh: 订阅账户登录需要在供应商网页或设备授权流程中确认；智能体可以打开入口，但不能代替用户完成外部认证。
control.reasonEn: Subscription sign-in requires confirmation in a provider web or device-authorization flow; the Agent can open the entry but cannot complete external authentication for the user.

items.titleZh: 选择主模型、快速模型、经济模型以及图像理解、图像生成和语音识别默认模型
items.titleEn: Choose Primary, Fast, Economy, image-understanding, image-generation, and speech-recognition defaults

control.reasonZh: “选择主模型、快速模型、经济模型以及图像理解、图像生成和语音识别默认模型”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose Primary, Fast, Economy, image-understanding, image-generation, and speech-recognition defaults” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 按模型能力选择推理预设或自定义思考预算
items.titleEn: Choose reasoning presets or a custom thinking budget per model

control.reasonZh: “按模型能力选择推理预设或自定义思考预算”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose reasoning presets or a custom thinking budget per model” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 配置智能模式路由：联动主模型、经济模型与路由分类模型
items.titleEn: Configure Smart Mode routing with Primary, Economy, and router classifier models

control.reasonZh: “配置智能模式路由：联动主模型、经济模型与路由分类模型”依赖当前执行宿主的路由支持状态以及主模型、经济模型与路由分类模型的连通校验，需要在模型设置弹窗中确认保存；智能体会直接为你定位到该入口。
control.reasonEn: “Configure Smart Mode routing with Primary, Economy, and router classifier models” depends on execution-host routing availability plus live connectivity checks across the Primary, Economy, and router classifier models; the Agent opens the exact model settings entry so you can configure and verify them.

items.titleZh: 管理多成员模型池、路由策略、健康状态与会话模型选择
items.titleEn: Manage multi-member model pools, routing strategies, health status, and session selection

control.reasonZh: 通过模型池编辑器选择已配置成员、顺序与路由策略，并查看健康状态。
control.reasonEn: Use the pool editor to select configured members, their order and routing strategy, and inspect health.

items.titleZh: 测试模型连接或实测图像生成服务，并刷新运行时客户端
items.titleEn: Test model connections or standalone image generation and refresh the runtime client

control.reasonZh: “测试模型连接或实测图像生成服务，并刷新运行时客户端”需要用户在具体配置卡片中主动发起；图像生成测试会实际调用远端接口并可能产生费用，智能体只会打开对应设置入口。
control.reasonEn: “Test model connections or standalone image generation and refresh the runtime client” requires starting the check on a chosen configuration; image-service tests generate an actual image and may consume quota, so the Agent only opens the settings entry.

items.titleZh: 设置或取消首次响应超时与响应间隔超时（默认均 600 秒）
items.titleEn: Set or disable First response timeout and Response idle timeout (600s default)

items.titleZh: 配置 AI 请求使用的 HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 网络代理与绕过规则
items.titleEn: Configure HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5 network proxies and bypass rules for AI requests

control.reasonZh: “配置 AI 请求使用的 HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 网络代理与绕过规则”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Configure HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5 network proxies and bypass rules for AI requests” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 按供应商添加自定义 Header、请求体扩展字段与 SSL 证书校验行为
items.titleEn: Add custom headers, extra request-body fields, and SSL verification behavior per provider

control.reasonZh: 自定义 Header 与请求体可能包含令牌或其他秘密值，必须通过受保护的模型配置入口编辑，不能进入智能体可读目录。
control.reasonEn: Custom headers and request bodies may contain tokens or other secrets, so they must be edited in the protected model configuration flow and cannot enter Agent-readable discovery data.

items.titleZh: 让智能体读取当前已配置且可用的模型与能力清单
items.titleEn: Let an agent inspect models and capabilities available under the current configuration

workflowZh: 用 ListModels 读取当前运行时真实可用模型及其能力，再基于用户任务选择
模型列表为空或供应商不可用时返回具体配置状态，并打开模型设置；不得猜测模型 ID
workflowEn: Use ListModels to read models and capabilities actually available to the current runtime before choosing for the task
If no model is available or a provider is unhealthy, surface the specific configuration state and open model settings; never guess model IDs

items.titleZh: 查看 models.dev 目录同步状态、手动刷新并打开本地缓存目录
items.titleEn: Inspect models.dev catalog sync status, refresh manually, and reveal the local cache folder

control.reasonZh: ListModels 可读取运行时可用模型，但 models.dev 刷新、缓存定位和维护仍属于设置界面生命周期。
control.reasonEn: ListModels reads runtime-available models, while models.dev refresh, cache reveal, and maintenance remain owned by the Settings lifecycle.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 模型”
登录订阅账号（或配置多号订阅池），或添加内置/自定义供应商、Magpie 网关并点击“测试”确认连通
在默认模型区指定主模型、快速模型与经济模型，按需绑定图像理解、独立图像生成或语音识别服务
需要自动分流或高可用时，配置“智能模式”路由或新建多成员模型池；若调整了“更多设置”中的代理、首次响应超时或响应间隔超时，记得点击对应项的保存按钮（“保存”、“保存首次响应超时”或“保存响应超时”）
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Models
Sign in to a subscription account (or pool), or add a built-in/custom provider or Magpie gateway and click Test to verify connectivity
Assign your Primary, Fast, and Economy default models, plus optional vision, standalone image-generation, or speech services

Optionally configure Smart Mode routing or a multi-member model pool; if you edited proxy or timeout fields under More settings, click each control’s save button (Save, Save first response timeout, or Save response timeouts)

options.descriptionZh: 发出请求后等待首段有效响应的最长秒数（默认 600 秒）；设为 null（或界面留空）表示不限时，适合深度思考耗时较长的推理模型。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum seconds to wait for the first valid output after sending a request (600s default); null (or blank in UI) disables the timeout.

options.descriptionZh: 响应开始后等待下一段数据块的最长秒数（默认 600 秒）；设为 null（或界面留空）表示不限时。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum seconds to wait for the next data chunk after streaming starts (600s default); null (or blank in UI) disables the timeout.

capabilities.summaryZh: 设定智能体执行工具时的默认安全边界（需要确认、自动审批或完全访问），配置自动审批审查模型与超时兜底策略，并集中维护全局 Allow / Ask / Deny 规则。
capabilities.summaryEn: Set the default safety posture for agent tool calls (Ask, Auto-approve, or Full access), configure the auto-approval screener model and timeout fallbacks, and manage global Allow / Ask / Deny rules.
highlightsZh: 清晰对比“需要确认（默认）”、“自动审批”与带风险确认的“完全访问”三档模式
自动审批支持复用快速/主模型等聊天模型，或接入专用 Jev 决策模型（jev-latest）
可调 1–300 秒审批超时（默认 30 秒），自由指定模型不确定或异常时的回退动作
统一编排全局 Allow / Ask / Deny 规则，并控制聊天输入框底部的权限切换器显隐
highlightsEn: Compare Ask (default), Auto-approve, and warning-gated Full access permission postures
Power Auto-approve with your Fast/Primary chat model or the dedicated Jev decision model (jev-latest)
Tune the 1–300s approval timeout (30s default) and choose ask-vs-reject fallbacks on uncertainty or errors
Order global Allow / Ask / Deny baseline rules and toggle the composer permission-mode switcher

items.titleZh: 在需要确认（默认）、自动审批与完全访问三种默认权限模式间切换
items.titleEn: Switch the default permission mode between Ask (default), Auto-approve, and Full access

control.reasonZh: “在需要确认（默认）、自动审批与完全访问三种默认权限模式间切换”会改变后续工具调用的安全边界（切换到完全访问还需显式确认高风险警告）；智能体会打开权限规则页交由你亲自选择。
control.reasonEn: “Switch the default permission mode between Ask (default), Auto-approve, and Full access” changes your tool-execution safety boundary (and Full access requires an explicit high-risk confirmation dialog); the Agent opens Permission Rules so you choose directly.

items.titleZh: 为自动审批选择聊天审查模型或专用 Jev 决策模型并加密保存凭据
items.titleEn: Choose a chat screener model or dedicated Jev decision model for auto-approval with encrypted credentials

control.reasonZh: 专用决策模型（Jev）的 API Key 属于设备级机密凭据，必须在受保护的权限规则设置页中录入或清除，智能体不会读取或回显密钥原值。
control.reasonEn: The dedicated Jev decision-model API key is a device-encrypted secret that must be saved or cleared in the protected Permission Rules form; the Agent never reads or echoes raw keys.

items.titleZh: 设置自动审批超时（默认 30 秒）及模型不确定或报错时的兜底动作
items.titleEn: Configure auto-approval timeout (30s default) and fallback actions on uncertainty or errors

control.reasonZh: “设置自动审批超时（默认 30 秒）及模型不确定或报错时的兜底动作”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Configure auto-approval timeout (30s default) and fallback actions on uncertainty or errors” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 编辑与排序全局 Allow、Ask、Deny 权限规则
items.titleEn: Edit and order global Allow, Ask, and Deny permission rules

control.reasonZh: “编辑与排序全局 Allow、Ask、Deny 权限规则”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Edit and order global Allow, Ask, and Deny permission rules” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 控制是否在聊天输入框下方显示权限模式快捷选择器
items.titleEn: Choose whether to show the quick permission-mode switcher below the chat input

control.reasonZh: “控制是否在聊天输入框下方显示权限模式快捷选择器”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose whether to show the quick permission-mode switcher below the chat input” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”
在“默认权限模式”中选择“需要确认”、“自动审批”或“完全访问”，并按习惯决定是否在聊天输入框下方保留快捷切换器
若选择“自动审批”，在下方挑选聊天审查模型（推荐快速模型）或配置专用决策模型（Jev）及加密 API Key，再核对 30 秒超时与异常兜底策略
在“全局规则”行点击“管理规则”，添加并排序跨项目通用的允许、询问或拒绝规则后保存
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Permission Rules
Under Default permission mode, pick Ask for confirmation, Automatic approval, or Full access, and choose whether to show the quick switcher below the chat input
If using Automatic approval, select a chat screener model (Fast model recommended) or configure Decision model (Jev) and its encrypted API key, then review the 30s timeout and fallback policies
Click Manage rules beside Global rules to add, reorder, and save cross-workspace Allow, Ask, or Deny rules

capabilities.summaryZh: 控制 OpenBitFun 是否自动生成记忆并在会话中使用记忆，支持自定义外部工具隐私策略、BTW 侧问参与度、两阶段提取/整理模型、会话回溯与候选保留天数及本地记忆目录维护。
capabilities.summaryEn: Control whether OpenBitFun generates memories automatically and uses memories in sessions, with fine-grained privacy rules for external tool outputs, BTW side-chat opt-in, two-stage models, lookback and candidate retention windows, and local folder access.
highlightsZh: 界面可分别开关“自动生成记忆”与“在会话中使用记忆”（或让智能体一键同步开关两项）
两阶段流水线：会话空闲后后台提取候选记忆，再归并整理为精炼长期经验
三种外部工具上下文隐私策略（默认清除工具原始输出），守护外部敏感数据
可分别为提取阶段与整理阶段指定轻量或主力模型，兼顾质量与 Token 成本
右上角“⋯”菜单支持直接打开本地记忆文件夹审阅编修、恢复默认参数或一键清空记忆
highlightsEn: Toggle Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions in Settings (or let an agent switch both together)
Two-stage pipeline extracts raw candidates from idle chats and consolidates them into durable notes
Three privacy policies for external tool context—stripping raw tool outputs by default
Assign separate models for Phase 1 extraction and Phase 2 consolidation to balance cost and quality
Use the ⋯ menu to open the local memory folder for manual inspection/pruning, reset defaults, or erase all memories

items.titleZh: 启用或停用“自动生成记忆”与“在会话中使用记忆”
items.titleEn: Enable or disable Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions

items.titleZh: 决定 BTW 顺手侧问是否参与长期记忆提取
items.titleEn: Choose whether lightweight BTW side-questions contribute to memory

items.titleZh: 存在外部工具上下文时选择清除工具结果、允许保留或跳过整个会话
items.titleEn: Choose whether external tool context clears tool results, is allowed, or skips the session

items.titleZh: 设置提取前最短空闲时长、会话回溯天数与启动扫描上限
items.titleEn: Set minimum idle hours, Session lookback days, and startup scan limits

items.titleZh: 设置第一阶段记忆提取并发数与原始候选上限
items.titleEn: Set Phase 1 memory-extraction concurrency and the raw-candidate limit

items.titleZh: 从已启用模型中选择第一阶段记忆提取模型或跟随主模型
items.titleEn: Choose the Phase 1 memory-extraction model or follow the Primary model

control.reasonZh: 可选模型集合来自当前启用的模型配置，必须按实时列表选择；智能体可准确打开该设置而不会把任意字符串冒充为有效模型。
control.reasonEn: The choices come from the live set of enabled model configurations and must be selected against that list; the Agent can open the exact setting without pretending any arbitrary string is a valid model.

items.titleZh: 选择第二阶段记忆整理模型（跟随主模型、提取模型或指定模型）
items.titleEn: Choose the Phase 2 consolidation model (follow Primary, Extraction, or a specific model)

control.reasonZh: “选择第二阶段记忆整理模型（跟随主模型、提取模型或指定模型）”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose the Phase 2 consolidation model (follow Primary, Extraction, or a specific model)” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 设置未被使用的候选保留天数
items.titleEn: Set Candidate retention days for unused raw memories

items.titleZh: 通过“⋯”菜单打开本地记忆目录、恢复默认设置或清空全部记忆
items.titleEn: Open the local memory folder, restore default settings, or erase all memories from the ⋯ menu

control.reasonZh: “通过“⋯”菜单打开本地记忆目录、恢复默认设置或清空全部记忆”包含不可逆的清空确认或文件管理器跳转；智能体会直接打开记忆设置区块，由你在可见界面中确认操作。
control.reasonEn: “Open the local memory folder, restore default settings, or erase all memories from the ⋯ menu” includes destructive erase confirmation or opening the host file manager; the Agent opens the Memory section so you confirm visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 会话与记忆”并滚动到“记忆”区块
按需开启“自动生成记忆”和“在会话中使用记忆”两个开关，并确认 BTW 侧问参与度与外部上下文隐私策略
需要精细调优时，分别指定第一阶段提取模型、第二阶段整理模型，以及空闲时长、“会话回溯天数”与“候选保留天数”
想查看智能体到底记住了什么，点击记忆标题栏右上角的“⋯ → 打开记忆目录”直接浏览或修剪文件
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, go to Models & Agents → Sessions & Memory, and scroll to the Memory section
Toggle Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions as needed, then review BTW side-session participation and the External context policy
Optionally tune Phase 1 extraction and Phase 2 consolidation models along with idle hours, Session lookback days, and Candidate retention
Click ⋯ → Open memory folder in the Memory header anytime to inspect, edit, or prune what was learned

options.descriptionZh: 仅从最近指定天数以内的历史会话提取记忆（不大于候选保留天数）。

options.titleZh: 每次启动扫描会话上限
options.descriptionZh: 每次启动应用寻找记忆候选时最多扫描的历史会话总数。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum historical sessions scanned for memory candidates per app launch.

options.descriptionZh: 限制第一阶段同时运行的后台记忆提取任务数。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum concurrent Phase 1 background extraction tasks.

options.descriptionZh: 限制送入第二阶段去重整理的第一阶段原始候选记忆条数。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum Phase 1 raw memory candidates passed into Phase 2 consolidation.

options.descriptionZh: 设置长期未被召回使用的原始候选记忆最多保留多少天。
options.descriptionEn: Number of days unused raw memory candidates are kept before automatic cleanup.

capabilities.titleZh: 会话与工作区搜索设置
capabilities.summaryZh: 管理新建会话的默认智能体执行模式、会话标题自动生成与选型、答复后的下一步候选建议，以及本地项目的加速全文搜索开关。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure the Default agent execution mode for new sessions, automatic session titles and their model, post-reply next-step suggestions, and accelerated local workspace search.
highlightsZh: 新建会话可跟随聊天输入框上次选择，也可固定为你偏爱的默认智能体执行模式
自动根据首轮对话归纳清晰会话标题，并可绑定快速模型降低延迟与开销
智能体回复后在聊天输入框给出一句话追问建议，按 Tab 或 → 即可采纳
在本地仓库开启加速搜索以提速代码查找，远程工作区自动切换远程搜索路径
highlightsEn: Let new sessions follow your last chat input choice or lock in a preferred Default agent execution mode
Generate clear session titles automatically and bind them to your Fast model to save latency
Show a one-line next-step prompt suggestion in the chat input after replies—press Tab or → to accept
Enable accelerated local repository search while remote workspaces cleanly use remote search paths

items.titleZh: 设置默认智能体执行模式：跟随聊天输入框上一次选择，或固定默认模式
items.titleEn: Set Default agent execution mode: follow the last chat input selection or fix a default mode

control.reasonZh: “设置默认智能体执行模式：跟随聊天输入框上一次选择，或固定默认模式”由“会话与记忆”设置页中的关联控件共同管理，目前没有单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开该入口供你选择。
control.reasonEn: “Set Default agent execution mode: follow the last chat input selection or fix a default mode” is managed by linked controls on the Sessions & Memory settings page; the Agent opens the exact section so you can pick visibly.

items.titleZh: 启用或停用根据会话内容自动生成标题
items.titleEn: Enable or disable automatic titles generated from session content

items.titleZh: 让标题模型继承快速模型、主模型或使用指定轻量模型
items.titleEn: Make title generation inherit the Fast or Primary model, or use a selected lightweight model

control.reasonZh: “让标题模型继承快速模型、主模型或使用指定轻量模型”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Make title generation inherit the Fast or Primary model, or use a selected lightweight model” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 启用或停用智能体答复后在聊天输入框显示的一句话候选建议
items.titleEn: Enable or disable the one-sentence next-step suggestion in the chat input after replies

items.titleZh: 远程工作区明确走远端搜索数据面，绝不静默回退到本机文件
items.titleEn: Use an explicit remote-workspace search path without silently falling back to local files

control.reasonZh: “远程工作区明确走远端搜索数据面，绝不静默回退到本机文件”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Use an explicit remote-workspace search path without silently falling back to local files” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 为本地工作区启用 Flashgrep 加速搜索
items.titleEn: Enable Flashgrep-backed accelerated search for local workspaces

items.titleZh: 后台自动维护本地 Flashgrep 搜索索引并在文件搜索入口查看状态
items.titleEn: Maintain local Flashgrep search indexes automatically and inspect status from search surfaces

control.reasonZh: “后台自动维护本地 Flashgrep 搜索索引并在文件搜索入口查看状态”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Maintain local Flashgrep search indexes automatically and inspect status from search surfaces” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 会话与记忆”
在“默认智能体执行模式”中选择跟随上一次选择或固定默认模式，并按需调整自动生成会话标题（及标题模型）与候选输入建议开关
如需调整本地项目的代码加速搜索开关，切换到左侧“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”开启或关闭“启用加速工作区搜索”
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Sessions & Memory
Under Default agent execution mode, choose whether new sessions follow your last selection or use a fixed mode, then adjust automatic session titles (and title model) and prompt suggestions
To toggle accelerated local repository search, switch to Programming & Development → Workspace & Git in the sidebar and toggle Enable accelerated workspace search

options.descriptionEn: Automatically summarize early conversation turns into a recognizable session title.

options.descriptionZh: 智能体答复完成后，在聊天输入框中提示一句话的下一步追问建议（按 Tab 或 → 采纳）。
options.descriptionEn: Suggest a one-sentence follow-up in the chat input after an agent reply (press Tab or → to accept).

options.descriptionZh: 为本地工作区启用 Flashgrep 加速索引搜索（位于“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”，远程工作区自动停用隐藏）。
options.descriptionEn: Enable Flashgrep-backed indexed search for local workspaces (under Programming & Development → Workspace & Git; hidden on remote workspaces).

capabilities.summaryZh: 管理本地加速工作区搜索、AI Git 提交联合作者署名（Co-authored-by），以及并行隔离 Worktree 的存储目录、分支前缀、自动清理与生命周期。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure local accelerated workspace search, AI Git commit co-author attribution (`Co-authored-by`), and managed Git worktree root path, branch prefix, cleanup rules, and lifecycle.
highlightsZh: 本地工作区加速搜索开关（关闭后常规搜索照常可用，远程工作区自动隐藏）
Git 提交署名：控制智能体提交时是否默认附带 Co-authored-by 联合作者标记
受管 Worktree 统一根目录（默认 ~/.openbitfun/worktrees）、分支前缀与自动清理保留上限（默认 15 个）
盘点当前执行主机上受管根目录内的现有 Worktree（未提交修改 / 未推送提交 / 关联会话）并安全清理
highlightsEn: Local accelerated workspace search toggle (falls back cleanly to normal search when off; hidden on remote workspaces)
Git commit attribution toggle for appending the OpenBitFun `Co-authored-by` trailer on AI-created commits (on by default)
Managed Worktree root (`~/.openbitfun/worktrees`), `openbitfun/` branch prefix, and auto-cleanup retention limit (default 15)
Managed-root Worktree inventory on the current execution host showing dirty files, unpushed commits, session restore, and safe/force removal

items.titleZh: 为本地工作区开启或关闭加速工作区搜索
items.titleEn: Enable or disable accelerated workspace search for local projects

control.reasonZh: “为本地工作区开启或关闭加速工作区搜索”会结合当前工作区是否为本机项目动态展示；智能体会为你打开“工作区与 Git → 加速工作区搜索”区域。
control.reasonEn: “Enable or disable accelerated workspace search for local projects” renders dynamically when a local workspace is active; the Agent opens Workspace & Git → Accelerated Workspace Search for you.

items.titleZh: 开启或关闭智能体创建 Git 提交时的 Co-authored-by 联合作者署名
items.titleEn: Enable or disable OpenBitFun Co-authored-by attribution on agent-created Git commits

control.reasonZh: “开启或关闭智能体创建 Git 提交时的 Co-authored-by 联合作者署名”可在“工作区与 Git → Git 提交署名”中一键切换并即时保存；智能体会为你直达该开关位置。
control.reasonEn: “Enable or disable OpenBitFun Co-authored-by attribution on agent-created Git commits” toggles immediately under Workspace & Git → Git Commit Attribution; the Agent opens that exact section for you.

items.titleZh: 了解会话级隔离 Worktree 机制并配置创建与清理默认策略
items.titleEn: Understand per-session isolated worktrees and configure creation and cleanup defaults

control.reasonZh: 是否为某个新会话启用隔离需要在创建会话时结合仓库状态选择；此设置页只保存隔离 Worktree 的默认参数，契约不会虚构一个不存在的全局启用开关。
control.reasonEn: Whether a new session uses isolation is selected at session creation against the live repository state; this page stores only managed-worktree defaults, so the contract does not invent a global enable switch.

items.titleZh: 设置受管 Worktree 的统一存放根目录（默认 ~/.openbitfun/worktrees）
items.titleEn: Set the common storage root directory for managed worktrees (`~/.openbitfun/worktrees` by default)

items.titleZh: 设置隔离工作树自动新建分支的名称前缀（默认 openbitfun/）
items.titleEn: Set the branch-name prefix used for automatically created worktree branches (`openbitfun/` by default)

items.titleZh: 选择新建隔离工作树时是否带上当前未提交的本地改动
items.titleEn: Choose whether uncommitted local edits are copied into newly created isolated worktrees

items.titleZh: 启用受管 Worktree 自动清理并设定最多保留数量（默认保留 15 个）
items.titleEn: Enable automatic worktree cleanup and set the maximum retained count (15 by default)

items.titleZh: 盘点受管 Worktree 的生命周期、未提交改动、未发布提交与关联会话
items.titleEn: Inspect managed worktree lifecycle, dirty files, unpublished commits, and linked sessions

workflowZh: 若 Worktree 是延迟工具，先加载契约，再用 list 读取受管 Worktree 与关联会话
Worktree 工具只在本地主项目可用；远程工作区必须明确报告不支持，不得在控制器仓库上代跑
workflowEn: Load Worktree if deferred, then use list to inspect managed worktrees and associated sessions
Worktree is available only for the local main project; remote workspaces must report unsupported instead of operating on the controller repository

items.titleZh: 一键打开或恢复关联会话，并在脏工作区/未发布提交保护检查后删除 Worktree
items.titleEn: Open or restore linked sessions and safely delete or force-delete worktrees after protection checks

control.reasonZh: “一键打开或恢复关联会话，并在脏工作区/未发布提交保护检查后删除 Worktree”涉及跨会话跳转及未保存代码/未推送提交的安全确认弹窗；智能体会打开管理列表由你核对确认。
control.reasonEn: “Open or restore linked sessions and safely delete or force-delete worktrees after protection checks” involves jumping across sessions or confirming protection warnings for uncommitted edits and unpushed commits; the Agent opens the management list so you stay in control.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”
按需切换“加速工作区搜索”与“Git 提交署名”开关（这两项立即生效）
在“Worktrees”默认参数区修改根目录、分支前缀或清理上限后点击该区域底部的“保存”（右上角可“恢复默认值”），并在下方管理列表巡检或清理受管 Worktree
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Programming & Development → Workspace & Git
Toggle Accelerated Workspace Search or Git Commit Attribution at the top (both save immediately)

Edit root path, branch prefix, or cleanup limit under Worktrees and click Save in the action bar at the bottom of the defaults section (Reset to defaults sits in the section header), or manage existing checkouts below
agentExamplesZh: 打开工作区与 Git 设置
把受管 Worktree 自动清理上限改成 25 个
帮我看看当前项目有哪些受管 Worktree 还没清理
agentExamplesEn: Open Workspace & Git settings
Set the managed worktree retention limit to 25
List managed worktrees for this project and check if any have uncommitted changes

options.descriptionZh: OpenBitFun 集中存放受管隔离 Worktree 的根目录（留空使用默认 `~/.openbitfun/worktrees`）。
options.descriptionEn: Root folder where OpenBitFun places managed isolated worktrees (defaults to `~/.openbitfun/worktrees` when left blank).

options.descriptionZh: 隔离工作树自动新建 Git 分支时使用的名称前缀（默认 `openbitfun/`）。
options.descriptionEn: Prefix prepended to branch names created automatically for isolated worktrees (`openbitfun/` by default).

options.descriptionZh: 创建隔离 Worktree 时是否把当前工作区未提交的本地修改一并复制过去（默认关闭）。
options.descriptionEn: Copy current uncommitted workspace edits into newly created isolated worktrees (off by default).

options.descriptionZh: 超出保留上限时自动清理已完成且干净的旧受管 Worktree（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically prune older clean managed worktrees once the retention limit is exceeded (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 触发自动清理前最多保留的受管 Worktree 数量（范围 1–100，默认 15）。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum number of managed worktrees retained before automatic cleanup runs (1–100, default 15).

items.titleZh: 开启“按需加载工具”（延迟加载工具），减少智能体初始上下文

control.reasonZh: “设置向用户提问的最长等待响应时间（默认 180 秒）”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Set how long user questions wait for your reply (180s default)” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

control.reasonZh: 可选目标来自当前实时启用的模型与模型池列表，需在“执行与协作”设置页按当前目录选择；单个子智能体的独立模型仍可在智能体管理中覆盖。
control.reasonEn: Selectable targets come from your live enabled models and model pools in Execution & Collaboration settings, while per-subagent overrides live in Agent management.

control.reasonEn: “Review, revoke, or clear remembered project permission grants and audit records” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

control.reasonEn: Operating-system permissions require user confirmation in system UI; the Agent can open the exact entry without pretending that an app setting grants OS authorization.

items.titleZh: 控制 OpenBitFun 启动时是否自动连接外部 CDP 浏览器
items.titleEn: Choose whether OpenBitFun automatically connects to your CDP browser on startup

control.reasonZh: 可用浏览器和 CDP 状态来自当前机器且可能要求重启确认；智能体可打开配置入口，实际网页操作则使用统一的 ControlHub 浏览器契约。
control.reasonEn: Available browsers and CDP state come from the current machine and may require restart confirmation; the Agent can open setup, while page automation uses the shared ControlHub browser contract.
